jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Warehouse

## Job Description

Job Title: Goods Receipt Specialist

Reports to: Team Leader Goods In

Career Band: 2

Division: Clinical Trial Division (CTD)

## Position Summary

The Goods Receipt Specialist is responsible for the timely receipt, booking, and storage of materials. The role records deviations in the TrackWise system and supports investigations. The incumbent ensures compliance with SOPs, GCP, cGMP, and safety requirements and monitors documentation practices within the eDMS.

## Responsibilities

- Ensure compliance with SOPs, GxP guidelines, and internal/external safety regulations
- Receive goods, post goods receipts in GPMS, and hand over shipments to freight carriers
- Perform high-bay warehouse picking activities and related WMS transactions
- Physically store materials and perform GPMS/WMS postings
- Execute required material movements, including transfers to external storage locations
- Operate machinery and equipment used for material handling
- Conduct inventory counts
- Clean facilities, machinery, and equipment according to instructions
- Support other departments as directed by supervisors

## Minimum Qualifications

- Completed vocational training in logistics
- At least two years of experience in industry or logistics
- Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and move heavier materials
- Very good German language skills, written and spoken
- Strong communication skills
- Ability to work independently under pressure in a multicultural environment
- Ability to meet deadlines and prioritize tasks
- Strong teamwork skills and resilience under stress
- Reliable, accurate, and efficient working style
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Preferred Qualifications

- Several years of experience in a regulated environment (e.g., pharmaceutical or food industry)
- Forklift license
- Class B driving license
- English language skills, written and spoken

This job description does not include all duties and responsibilities. Additional function-related instructions and assignments requested by management must be followed.

German:

## Interne Stellenbeschreibung

Job-Titel: Goods Receipt Specialist

Berichtet an: Team Leader Goods In

Karriere-Band: 2

## Zusammenfassende Positionsbeschreibung

Der Goods Receipt Specialist führt eine zeitgerechte Annahme, Einbuchung sowie Einlagerung von Materialien durch. Er erfasst Abweichungen im TrackWise-System und unterstützt Untersuchungen. Er stellt die Einhaltung gültiger SOPs, GCP-, cGMP- und Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften sicher und überwacht die Dokumentationspraxis im eDMS.

## Verantwortlichkeiten

- Einhaltung von SOPs, GxP-Richtlinien sowie internen und externen Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften
- Warenannahme, Wareneingangsbuchung im GPMS sowie Warenübergabe an Frachtführer
- Hochregallager-Kommissionierungen sowie Verbuchung im WMS
- Physische Einlagerung von Waren und Buchung im GPMS/WMS
- Durchführung notwendiger Warenbewegungen inklusive Transporte ins Aussenlager
- Bedienung von Maschinen und Ausrüstungen zur Warenbewegung
- Durchführung von Inventuren
- Reinigung von Räumlichkeiten, Maschinen und Ausrüstungen gemäss Anweisungen
- Einsatz in anderen Abteilungen gemäss Weisung der Vorgesetzten

## Minimale Qualifikationen

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logistiker
- Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in Industrie/Logistik
- Fähigkeit länger zu stehen und zu laufen sowie schwere Materialien zu bewegen
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten
- Selbstständige Arbeitsweise auch unter Druck in einem multikulturellen Umfeld
- Fähigkeit, Zeitvorgaben einzuhalten und Tätigkeiten zu priorisieren
- Hohe Teamfähigkeit und Stressbeständigkeit
- Zuverlässige, genaue und effiziente Arbeitsweise
- Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem regulierten Arbeitsumfeld (z. B. Pharma- oder Lebensmittelindustrie)
- Staplerführerschein
- Führerschein Klasse B
- Englische Sprachfertigkeiten in Wort und Schrift

Diese Stellenbeschreibung beschreibt nicht alle Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten. Weitere funktionsbezogene Anweisungen und Aufgaben sind entsprechend den Vorgaben der Vorgesetzten zu befolgen.

## Programma di lavoro

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Condizioni ambientali

magazzino

## Descrizione del lavoro

Titolo: Merci Ricezione Specialista

Rapporti a: Team Leader Goods In

Banda di Carriera: 2

Divisione di prova clinica (CTD)

## Posizione Sommario

Il Goods Receipt Specialist è responsabile per la ricezione tempestiva, la prenotazione e lo stoccaggio dei materiali. Il ruolo registra deviazioni nel sistema TrackWise e supporta le indagini. L'incumbent garantisce il rispetto dei requisiti SOP, GCP, cGMP e sicurezza e monitora le pratiche di documentazione all'interno dell'eDMS.

## responsabilità

- Assicurare il rispetto delle SOP, delle linee guida GxP e delle normative di sicurezza interne/esterne
- Ricevere merci, post merci ricevute in GPMS, e consegnare le spedizioni ai vettori merci
- Esegui attività di prelievo di magazzino ad alto livello e relative transazioni WMS
- Fisicamente memorizzare i materiali e eseguire le postazioni GPMS/WMS
- Eseguire i movimenti materiali necessari, compresi i trasferimenti in luoghi di archiviazione esterni
- Macchine e attrezzature per la movimentazione dei materiali
- Conteggio delle scorte di conduzione
- Impianti puliti, macchinari e attrezzature secondo le istruzioni
- Sostenere altri dipartimenti diretti dai supervisori

## Qualifiche minime

- Formazione professionale completa nella logistica
- Almeno due anni di esperienza nell'industria o nella logistica
- Capacità di resistere e camminare per lunghi periodi e spostare materiali più pesanti
- Molto buone competenze linguistiche tedesche, scritte e parlate
- Forte capacità di comunicazione
- Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente sotto pressione in un ambiente multiculturale
- Capacità di soddisfare le scadenze e priorità delle attività
- Forte capacità di lavoro di squadra e resilienza sotto stress
- Stile di lavoro affidabile, preciso ed efficiente
- Proficienza nelle applicazioni Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Qualificazioni predestinate

- Diversi anni di esperienza in un ambiente regolamentato (ad esempio, industria farmaceutica o alimentare)
- Licenza di carrello elevatore
- Patente di guida di classe B
- Inglese competenze linguistiche, scritte e parlate

Questa descrizione del lavoro non include tutti i doveri e le responsabilità. Devono essere seguite ulteriori istruzioni e assegnazioni relative alle funzioni richieste dalla direzione.

Reported: Team Leader Goods In

## Descrizione della posizione

Il Goods Receipt Specialist esegue un'accettazione tempestiva, la prenotazione e lo stoccaggio dei materiali. Rileva le deviazioni del sistema TrackWise e supporta le indagini. Garantisce il rispetto delle valide norme SOP, GCP, cGMP e sicurezza sul lavoro e monitora la pratica della documentazione nell'EDMS.

## Responsabilità

- Conformità con le SOP, le linee guida GxP e i regolamenti interni ed esterni in materia di sicurezza professionale
- Accettazione delle merci, prenotazione di ricevimento delle merci in GPMS e consegna delle merci ai vettori
- Rilevamento e prenotazione del magazzino in alto livello nel WMS
- Deposito fisico di merci e prenotazioni in GPMS/WMS
- Attuazione dei movimenti di merci necessari, compreso il trasporto al magazzino esterno
- Funzionamento di macchinari e attrezzature per la movimentazione di merci
- Attuazione degli inventari
- Pulizia di locali, macchinari e attrezzature secondo le istruzioni
- Distribuzione in altri reparti secondo le istruzioni dei superiori

## Titolo minimo

- Formazione completa come logistica
- Almeno due anni di esperienza nell'industria/logistica
- Capacità di resistere e camminare più a lungo e spostare materiali pesanti
- Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura
- Buone capacità di comunicazione
- Lavoro indipendente anche sotto pressione in un ambiente multiculturale
- Capacità di soddisfare le scadenze e priorità delle attività
- Alti livelli di lavoro di squadra e resistenza allo stress
- Metodi di lavoro affidabili, precisi ed efficienti
- Buona conoscenza di MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Le qualifiche previste

- Diversi anni di esperienza professionale in un ambiente di lavoro regolamentato (ad esempio industria farmaceutica o alimentare)
- Patente di guida per carrelli elevatori
- Titolo di guida della categoria B
- Inglese competenze linguistiche in parola e scrittura

Questa descrizione del lavoro non descrive tutti i compiti e le responsabilità. Ulteriori istruzioni e compiti funzionali sono seguiti secondo le istruzioni dei superiori.

## Calendrier des travaux

Norme (Mon-Fri)

## Conditions environnementales

Entrepôt

## Description du poste

Titre: Spécialiste de la réception des marchandises

Rapports à : Chef d'équipe

Bande professionnelle: 2

Division des essais cliniques

## Résumé du poste

Le spécialiste de la réception des marchandises est responsable de la réception, de la réservation et de l'entreposage des documents en temps opportun. Le rôle enregistre les écarts dans le système TrackWise et soutient les enquêtes. Le titulaire s'assure de la conformité aux SOP, au GCP, au GMPc et aux exigences de sécurité et surveille les pratiques de documentation au sein du SGD électronique.

## Responsabilités

- Assurer la conformité avec les SOP, les lignes directrices du GxP et les règlements de sécurité internes et externes
- Recevoir des marchandises, poster des reçus de marchandises dans le SGGP et remettre les expéditions aux transporteurs de marchandises
- Effectuer des activités de ramassage d'entrepôts à grande baie et des transactions connexes avec WMS
- Entreposage physique du matériel et affichage GPMS/WMS
- Exécuter les mouvements de matériel requis, y compris les transferts vers des sites de stockage externes
- Fonctionnement des machines et équipements utilisés pour la manutention des matériaux
- Effectuer des inventaires
- Nettoyage des installations, des machines et de l'équipement selon les instructions
- Appuyer les autres ministères conformément aux directives des superviseurs

## Qualités minimales

- Formation professionnelle complète en logistique
- Au moins deux ans d'expérience dans l'industrie ou la logistique
- Capacité de se tenir debout et de marcher pendant de longues périodes et de déplacer des matériaux plus lourds
- Très bonnes compétences en langue allemande, écrites et parlées
- Fortes compétences en communication
- Capacité de travailler de manière indépendante sous pression dans un environnement multiculturel
- Capacité de respecter les délais et de hiérarchiser les tâches
- Fortes compétences en travail d'équipe et résilience sous le stress
- Style de travail fiable, précis et efficace
- Compétence dans les applications Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Qualifications privilégiées

- Plusieurs années d'expérience dans un environnement réglementé (p. ex. industrie pharmaceutique ou alimentaire)
- Licence de chariot élévateur
- Permis de conduire de classe B
- Compétences en langue anglaise, écrite et parlée

Cette description de travail ne comprend pas toutes les tâches et responsabilités. Les instructions et les affectations supplémentaires demandées par la direction doivent être suivies.

Allemand:

## Description de travail interne

Titre: Spécialiste de la réception des marchandises

Déclaré: Chef d'équipe

Bande de carrières: 2

## Description sommaire de la position

Le spécialiste de la réception des marchandises effectue une acceptation, une réservation et un stockage en temps opportun du matériel. Il détecte les déviations dans le système TrackWise et soutient les enquêtes. Il veille à la conformité avec les SOP valides, le GCP, le GMPc et les règlements de sécurité au travail et surveille les pratiques de documentation dans le SGD électronique.

## Responsabilité

- Conformité aux normes SOP, aux directives GxP et aux règlements internes et externes en matière de sécurité au travail
- Acceptation des marchandises, réservation de réception des marchandises dans le SGGP et livraison des marchandises aux transporteurs
- Cueillette et réservation d'entrepôt dans le WMS
- Stockage physique des marchandises et réservation dans GPMS/WMS
- Mise en œuvre des mouvements de marchandises nécessaires, y compris le transport vers l'entrepôt extérieur
- Fonctionnement des machines et équipements pour le mouvement des marchandises
- Mise en œuvre des inventaires
- Nettoyage des locaux, des machines et du matériel conformément aux instructions
- Déploiement dans d'autres départements selon les instructions des supérieurs

## Qualifications minimales

- Formation complétée en tant que logisticien
- Au moins deux ans d'expérience dans l'industrie/logistique
- Capacité à se tenir debout et à marcher plus longtemps et à déplacer des matériaux lourds
- Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture
- Bonnes compétences en communication
- Travail indépendant même sous pression dans un environnement multiculturel
- Capacité de respecter les délais et de prioriser les activités
- Niveau élevé de travail d'équipe et de résistance au stress
- Méthodes de travail fiables, précises et efficaces
- Bonne connaissance de MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Titres préférés

- Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans un milieu de travail réglementé (p. ex. industrie pharmaceutique ou alimentaire)
- Permis de conduire de chariot élévateur
- Permis de conduire de catégorie B
- Compétences linguistiques anglaises en paroles et en écriture

Cette description de travail ne décrit pas toutes les tâches et responsabilités. D'autres instructions et tâches fonctionnelles doivent être suivies conformément aux instructions des supérieurs.

## Job Description

Business Title: In Process Inspector Operations

Reports to: Supervisor In Process Inspector Operations

Group/Division: PSG/Clinical Trial Division

Position Location: Allschwil Switzerland

Day/Shift (if applicable): Rotationsshift

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. ist der weltweit führende Partner für die Wissenschaft mit einem Umsatz von 20 Mrd. USD und

mehr als 70'000 Mitarbeitern in 50 Ländern. Unsere Mission ist es, unsere Kunden in die Lage zu versetzen, die Welt gesünder,

sauberer und sicherer zu machen.

Fisher Clinical Services GmbH ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. mit über 450 Mitarbeitern in der

Schweiz und ist marktführend in den Bereichen Clinical Supply Chain Management Services und klinischer Prüfmusterherstellung

sowie Logistik für Patienten weltweit. Für weitere Informationen über den Standort in Allschwil bei Basel, besuchen Sie unsere

Website: www.fisherclinicalservices.com

**In Process Inspector Operations / Mitarbeiter Inprozesskontrolle** Zusammenfassung der Funktion: Als In Process Inspector sind Sie für die Druck-Freigaben im Printshop zuständig, des weiteren erstellt der/die IPC Inspector/in Reprint Files und setzt die nachgedruckten Etiketten an der ursprünglichen Position wieder ein. Er/Sie prüft am Ende jedes Druckauftrages die Vollständigkeit und Korrektheit und gibt diesen danach im System frei. Alle fertigen Druckaufträge werden von dem In Process Inspector für den internen oder externen Versand vorbereitet. Der In Process Inspector bedient die Maschinen zur automatischen Kamerakontrolle der Etiketten. Ihr 
• Aufgaben: Überprüfung und Freigabe von Druckaufträgen Bedienung der Maschinen zur automatischen Kamerakontrolle der Etiketten GMP-gerechtes Dokumentieren der durchgeführten 
• Aufgaben Erstellen von Reprint Files Überprüfung der Druckdokumentation Freigeben der kontrollierten und fertigen Druckaufträge im Clinical Label Services System Bereitstellen der Ware für den externen und internen Versand 
• Ihr Profil:

Erfahrung in der Qualitätssicherung von Vorteil Erfahrung im Umgang mit Maschinen Erfahrung in der Pharma- oder Lebensmittelindustrie von Vorteil Sehr gute Deutschkentnisse in Wort und Schrift (Englischkentnisse von Vorteil) Erfahrung im Umgang mit Computern / Grundlagenwissen gänge MS-Office Anwendungen Eigenverantwortung, selbstständiges Arbeiten und Zuverlässigkeit Initiativ, flexibel und teamfähig Jede unserer 70.000 außergewöhnlichen Persönlichkeiten bei Thermo Fisher Scientific erzählt eine einzigartige Geschichte. Kommen Sie zu uns und leisten Sie einen Beitrag zu unserer einzigartigen Mission. [http://iobs.thermofisher.com](http://iobs.thermofisher.com/) Diese Stellenbeschreibung beschreibt nicht alle 
• Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten, welche in dieser Funktion ausgeführt werden müssen. Alle weiteren funktionbezogenen Anweisungen, Pflichten, 
• Aufgaben oder Verantwortlichkeiten, die vom Teamleader oder Manager angefordert werden, müssen entsprechend befolgt werden.

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Flex with On Call Duty

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
DESCRIPTION:
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific's Quality Assurance team and contribute to our mission to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As a Quality Engineer II, you will ensure compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements across our manufacturing operations. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, lead investigations, and implement corrective actions to maintain our high standards of product quality. This role offers exposure to innovative technologies and the opportunity to directly impact patient care through quality oversight of critical products.
REQUIREMENTS:
• Advanced Degree with no prior experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 2 years of quality assurance experience in GMP/ISO regulated environments, preferably in medical devices, pharmaceuticals or biotechnology
• Preferred Fields of Study: Life Sciences, Engineering, Chemistry or related scientific/technical field
• ISO 13485/FDA Lead Auditor certification beneficial
• ASQ certification (CQE, CQA) advantageous
• Strong knowledge of quality systems, cGMP regulations, and standards including ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820
• Expertise in quality tools and methodologies including risk management, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control
• Demonstrated experience leading investigations, analyzing quality data, and implementing effective corrective actions
• Excellent documentation and technical writing skills for developing SOPs, protocols and reports
• Strong proficiency in quality management software (TrackWise, SAP QM, etc.) and Microsoft Office suite
• Experience conducting internal audits and supporting external regulatory inspections
• Demonstrated ability to build consensus and collaborate across functions
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively in team environments
• Strong attention to detail with analytical and problem-solving capabilities
• Experience with statistical analysis tools and quality metrics reporting
• Project management skills and ability to prioritize effectively
• Ability to work in clean room environments when required
• Foreign language skills beneficial

## Work Schedule

Rotational shift days

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

## Job Description

## About Thermo Fisher Scientific

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Whether supporting life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, improving laboratory efficiency, or enabling the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions.

Our Lengnau site is a state-of-the-art, multi-purpose manufacturing facility designed for large-scale biologics production, offering flexible technologies from development through to commercial manufacturing.

## Position Summary

As a Manufacturing Professional –Upstream Processing, you will be responsible for executing manufacturing activities related to upstream processing and cleaning within a cGMP environment. You will operate automated production systems, ensure compliance with quality and safety standards, and support process optimization and new product introduction activities.

## Key Responsibilities

- Support **operational readiness** for media and buffer preparation, equipment preparation, and cleaning activities
- Execute **day-to-day manufacturing operations** in compliance with cGMP requirements
- Operate and monitor **automated production equipment**
- Own and maintain **Work Instructions (WI) and SOPs** within your area
- Support **Technology Transfer** activities and contribute to CVQ, PQ, and Process Validation execution
- Participate in **New Product Introduction (NPI)** activities
- Contribute to **Manufacturing Excellence initiatives** to ensure robust and efficient processes
- Assist in defining and optimizing **process parameters** during routine manufacturing campaigns
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, PCS)
- Ensure accurate **documentation and batch record completion**

## Qualifications & Requirements

- Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Food Science, or related field
- 1–3 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing in a **GMP environment**
- Strong understanding of **cGMP and quality compliance requirements**
- Hands-on, proactive mindset with strong attention to detail
- Experience with **automated systems and manufacturing equipment** is an advantage
- Good knowledge of **documentation practices and batch record execution**
- Strong **problem-solving and organizational skills**
- Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team
- Good communication skills
- Willingness to work **shift schedules and on-call duties**
- Commitment to **safety and quality culture**

## What We Offer

- Competitive compensation and annual incentive bonus
- Comprehensive healthcare and employee benefits
- Opportunities for career growth in a global organization
- A dynamic and innovative work environment
- A culture driven by **Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement**

## Our Mission

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, we are committed to enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Join a team of over 100,000 colleagues working together to solve complex challenges and support patients in need.

## Work Schedule

Rotational shift days

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

## Job Description

## About Thermo Fisher Scientific

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Whether supporting life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, improving laboratory efficiency, or enabling the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions.

Our Lengnau site is a state-of-the-art, multi-purpose manufacturing facility designed for large-scale biologics production, offering flexible technologies from development through to commercial manufacturing.

## Position Summary

As a Manufacturing Professional –Upstream Processing, you will be responsible for executing manufacturing activities related to upstream processing and cleaning within a cGMP environment. You will operate automated production systems, ensure compliance with quality and safety standards, and support process optimization and new product introduction activities.

## Key Responsibilities

- Support **operational readiness** for media and buffer preparation, equipment preparation, and cleaning activities
- Execute **day-to-day manufacturing operations** in compliance with cGMP requirements
- Operate and monitor **automated production equipment**
- Own and maintain **Work Instructions (WI) and SOPs** within your area
- Support **Technology Transfer** activities and contribute to CVQ, PQ, and Process Validation execution
- Participate in **New Product Introduction (NPI)** activities
- Contribute to **Manufacturing Excellence initiatives** to ensure robust and efficient processes
- Assist in defining and optimizing **process parameters** during routine manufacturing campaigns
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, PCS)
- Ensure accurate **documentation and batch record completion**

## Qualifications & Requirements

- Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Food Science, or related field
- 1–3 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing in a **GMP environment**
- Strong understanding of **cGMP and quality compliance requirements**
- Hands-on, proactive mindset with strong attention to detail
- Experience with **automated systems and manufacturing equipment** is an advantage
- Good knowledge of **documentation practices and batch record execution**
- Strong **problem-solving and organizational skills**
- Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team
- Good communication skills
- Willingness to work **shift schedules and on-call duties**
- Commitment to **safety and quality culture**

## What We Offer

- Competitive compensation and annual incentive bonus
- Comprehensive healthcare and employee benefits
- Opportunities for career growth in a global organization
- A dynamic and innovative work environment
- A culture driven by **Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement**

## Our Mission

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, we are committed to enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Join a team of over 100,000 colleagues working together to solve complex challenges and support patients in need.

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Able to lift 40 lbs. without assistance, Laboratory Setting

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Location: Field-based role covering Swiss, Austria, Germany and Italy, with willingness to travel to France, UK, and the Nordic region.

## Discover Impactful Work

Digital Science Solutions (D)SS supports customers’ scientific ecosystems, connecting Thermo Fisher’s digital capabilities through informatics solutions. DSS works with colleagues from other divisions and businesses across Thermo Fisher to drive collaborative solutions to customer challenges, helping to commercialize software projects by delivering end-to-end product, software and service capabilities which span complete scientific workflows.

**Discover Impactful Work** The main focus of the role is the repair, maintenance, and installation of Cytomat Products, Laboratory Automation (LAI) products, and selected third-party equipment at customer sites in Switzerland and across Europe. A key priority is also to actively support customer relationship activities to drive Customer Support Services and Service Contract sales within the assigned region.

## A Day in the Life:

- Schedule and perform on-site maintenance, repair, and installation of Cytomat and LAI systems
- Deliver on-site training on system service, maintenance, and basic operation
- Manage and maintain local spare parts inventory
- Ensure accurate and timely completion of service documentation, including reports, work orders, and quotes
- Diagnose issues remotely or via phone and coordinate on-site interventions when required
- Dispatch and manage third-party service providers when necessary and follow up on resolution
- Monitor contract, warranty, and service status for installed customer base

## What to expect:

- Extensive travel (75%+) across Switzerland and Europe
- Hands-on work with automation systems, robotics, and laboratory instrumentation
- A mix of remote diagnostics and on-site service activities
- Customer-facing role with strong relationship management focus
- Dynamic and fast-paced environment with technical challenges

## Keys to Success:

## Education

- Technology diploma in Mechatronics, Electro-mechanical Engineering, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent

## Experience

- Minimum of 5 years of practical field service experience or experience troubleshooting laboratory equipment and software
- Proven experience with automation systems, robotics, and/or instrumentation

## Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong multi-disciplinary technical expertise across software, electrical, and mechanical systems
- Proficiency with computers, serial communications, networking, and diagnostic tools
- Basic programming knowledge to interpret and understand system logic
- Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills using schematics, software tools, and technical documentation
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a strong customer focus
- Professional working proficiency in English and German is required, additional languages are advantageous
- Working knowledge of Momentum software is a plus
- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively
- Physical ability to lift up to 50 lbs and work in laboratory environments
- Availability to respond to urgent customer needs
- Commitment to following all safety protocols, including working in cleanroom environments

## Competencies

- Customer focus and service orientation
- Technical problem-solving and analytical thinking
- Accountability and reliability
- Effective communication and collaboration
- Adaptability and flexibility

**Benefits:** We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

**Apply today!** [http://jobs.thermofisher.com](http://jobs.thermofisher.com)

Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran

## Programma di lavoro

## Condizioni ambientali

In grado di sollevare 40 lbs. senza assistenza, Setting Laboratorio

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Forniamo ai nostri team globali le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, aiutando a superare la scienza, sviluppando soluzioni per alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, come proteggere l’ambiente, assicurarsi che il nostro cibo sia sicuro o aiutando a trovare cure per il cancro.

Location: Field-based role copre Svizzera, Austria, Germania e Italia, con la volontà di viaggiare in Francia, Regno Unito, e la regione nordica.

## Scopri il lavoro d'impatto

Digital Science Solutions (D)SS supporta gli ecosistemi scientifici dei clienti, collegando le capacità digitali di Thermo Fisher attraverso soluzioni informatiche. DSS lavora con colleghi di altre divisioni e aziende attraverso Thermo Fisher per guidare soluzioni collaborative alle sfide del cliente, aiutando a commercializzare i progetti software offrendo funzionalità di prodotto, software e servizi end-to-end che abbracciano flussi di lavoro scientifici completi.

**Scopri il lavoro d'impatto ** L'obiettivo principale del ruolo è la riparazione, la manutenzione e l'installazione dei prodotti Cytomat, l'automazione del laboratorio (LAI) e le attrezzature selezionate di terze parti presso i siti dei clienti in Svizzera e in tutta Europa. Una priorità fondamentale è anche sostenere attivamente le attività di relazione del cliente per guidare i servizi di assistenza clienti e le vendite del contratto di servizio all'interno della regione assegnata.

## Un giorno nella vita:

- Pianificare ed eseguire la manutenzione in loco, la riparazione e l'installazione di sistemi Cytomat e LAI
- Fornire formazione on-site sul servizio di sistema, manutenzione e funzionamento di base
- Gestione e manutenzione dell'inventario dei pezzi di ricambio locali
- Assicurare il completamento accurato e tempestivo della documentazione di servizio, inclusi rapporti, ordini di lavoro e preventivi
- Diagnosi dei problemi da remoto o via telefono e coordinamento degli interventi in loco quando necessario
- Distribuire e gestire fornitori di servizi di terze parti quando necessario e seguire la risoluzione
- Monitorare il contratto, la garanzia e lo stato di servizio per la base di clienti installata

## Cosa aspettarsi:

- Estesi viaggi (75%+) in Svizzera e in Europa
- Lavoro manuale con sistemi di automazione, robotica e strumentazione di laboratorio
- Un mix di diagnostica remota e attività di servizio in loco
- Il ruolo rivolto ai clienti con un forte focus sulla gestione delle relazioni
- Ambiente dinamico e veloce con sfide tecniche

## Le chiavi di successo:

## Istruzione

- Diploma tecnologico in Meccatronica, Ingegneria elettromeccanica, Ingegneria elettrica o meccanica, o equivalente

## Esperienza

- Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza pratica di servizio sul campo o di esperienza guasti attrezzature di laboratorio e software
- Esperienza comprovata con sistemi di automazione, robotica e/o strumentazione

## Conoscenza, abilità, abilità

## Stellenbeschreibung

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kollegen erwecken wir unsere Mission jeden Tag zum Leben, damit unsere Kunden die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer machen können. Wir stellen unseren globalen Teams die Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um individuelle Karriereziele zu erreichen, und helfen gleichzeitig, die Wissenschaft einen Schritt weiter zu bringen, indem wir Lösungen für einige der schwierigsten Herausforderungen der Welt entwickeln, wie den Schutz der Umwelt, die Gewährleistung der Sicherheit unserer Lebensmittel oder die Suche nach Heilmitteln für Krebs.

Standort: Feldbasierte Rolle in der Schweiz, Österreich, Deutschland und Italien, mit der Bereitschaft, nach Frankreich, Großbritannien und in die nordische Region zu reisen.

## Entdecken Sie wirkungsvolle Arbeit

Digital Science Solutions (D)SS unterstützt die wissenschaftlichen Ökosysteme der Kunden und verbindet die digitalen Fähigkeiten von Thermo Fisher durch Informatiklösungen. DSS arbeitet mit Kollegen aus anderen Divisionen und Unternehmen von Thermo Fisher zusammen, um kollaborative Lösungen für Kundenherausforderungen voranzutreiben und dabei zu helfen, Softwareprojekte zu kommerzialisieren, indem es durchgängige Produkt-, Software- und Servicefunktionen bereitstellt, die vollständige wissenschaftliche Arbeitsabläufe umfassen.

**Entdecken Sie wirkungsvolle Arbeit ** Der Schwerpunkt der Rolle liegt in der Reparatur, Wartung und Installation von Cytomat-Produkten, Laborautomationsprodukten (LAI) und ausgewählten Drittgeräten an Kundenstandorten in der Schweiz und in ganz Europa. - Dispatch und Verwaltung von Drittanbietern bei Bedarf und Weiterverfolgung der Lösung
- Überwachen Sie Vertrag, Garantie und Servicestatus für den installierten Kundenstamm

## Was zu erwarten ist:

- Umfangreiche Reisen (75%+) in der Schweiz und Europa
- Hands-on-Arbeit mit Automatisierungssystemen, Robotik und Laborinstrumenten
- Eine Mischung aus Ferndiagnose und Serviceaktivitäten vor Ort
- Kundenorientierte Rolle mit starkem Beziehungsmanagement-Fokus
- Dynamische und schnelle Umgebung mit technischen Herausforderungen

## Schlüssel zum Erfolg:

## Bildung

- Technologiediplom in Mechatronik, Elektromechanik, Elektrotechnik oder Maschinenbau oder gleichwertiges

## Erfahrung

- Mindestens 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Außendienst oder Erfahrung in der Fehlerbehebung von Laborgeräten und -software
- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Automatisierungssystemen, Robotik und/oder Instrumenten

## Wissen, Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeiten

- Starke multidisziplinäre technische Expertise in Software, elektrischen und mechanischen Systemen
- Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Computern, serieller Kommunikation, Vernetzung und Diagnose-Tools
- Grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse zur Interpretation und zum Verständnis der Systemlogik
- Starke Diagnose- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit Schaltplänen, Software-Tools und technischer Dokumentation
- Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig innerhalb eines Teams effektiv zusammenzuarbeiten
- Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten mit starker Kundenorientierung
- Professionelle Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich, zusätzliche Sprachen sind vorteilhaft
- Kenntnisse der Momentum-Software sind ein Plus
- Gültiger Führerschein und Reisebereitschaft
- Körperliche Fähigkeit, bis zu 50 lbs zu heben und in Laborumgebungen zu arbeiten
- Verfügbarkeit, um auf dringende Kundenbedürfnisse zu reagieren
- Verpflichtung zur Einhaltung aller Sicherheitsprotokolle, einschließlich der Arbeit in Reinraumumgebungen

## Kompetenzen

- Kundenorientierung und Serviceorientierung
- Technische Problemlösung und analytisches Denken
- Rechenschaftspflicht und Zuverlässigkeit
- Effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit
- Anpassungsfähigkeit und Flexibilität

**Vorteile:** Wir bieten eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung, einen jährlichen Incentive-Plan-Bonus, eine Gesundheitsversorgung und eine Reihe von Arbeitnehmerleistungen. Thermo Fisher Scientific bietet eine Beschäftigung mit einer innovativen, zukunftsweisenden Organisation und hervorragenden Karriere- und Entwicklungsperspektiven. Wir bieten eine spannende Unternehmenskultur, die für Integrität, Intensität, Engagement und Innovation steht!

Unsere Mission ist es, unseren Kunden zu ermöglichen, die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer zu machen. Sehen Sie, wie unsere Kollegen 5 Gründe erklären, mit uns zu arbeiten. - Fortes compétences en diagnostic et résolution de problèmes à l'aide de schémas, d'outils logiciels et de documentation technique
- Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en collaborant efficacement au sein d'une équipe
- Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication avec une forte orientation client
- Compétence professionnelle de travail en anglais et en allemand est nécessaire, langues supplémentaires sont avantageux
- La connaissance pratique du logiciel Momentum est un plus
- Permis de conduire valide et volonté de voyager largement

- Engagement à respecter tous les protocoles de sécurité, y compris le travail dans des environnements propres

## Compétences

- Orientation client et service
- Résolution de problèmes techniques et réflexion analytique
- Responsabilité et fiabilité

## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Position Summary:

The Senior Technical Sales Specialist (TSS) for Single-Use Technologies is a role within the sales organization of the BioProduction Group. This role will actively handle funnel opportunities for near-term revenue gains and develop new opportunities to build a strong pipeline for future growth, while maintaining current business relationships and organic growth. This individual will apply their sales experience, bioprocess knowledge, product expertise, market intelligence, and territory leadership skills to grow sales and profitability.

## Key Responsibilities:

- Searches for new opportunities and uses product portfolio to build a foundation for long term growth
- Drives existing funnel of opportunities to accelerate closure rates
- Applies intelligence-based prospecting to identify new potential opportunities
- Prioritizes New Product Introduction (NPI) prospects within territory to improve adoption rates and revenue return
- Acts on marketing-qualified leads, quickly converting to new opportunities
- Collaborates with and influences Bioproduction Account Managers (BAMs) and Field Application Scientists (FAS) within their district to develop and lead account growth strategies
- Assists all BioProduction Account Managers within assigned territory with sales and account planning efforts to achieve sales goals
- Aids in development of technical solution-matching for complex opportunities
- Maintains and improves technical knowledge on assigned product lines, company literature, and driven products

## Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in a life-science related field required, such as Biology, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or Engineering
- 7+ years of combined sales or adjacent functional experience working in a role related to the bioproduction process. Single Use preferred
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions and departments
- Technical understanding of bioproduction workflows and applications
- Shows good judgment and tact when dealing with internal and external customers
- Must possess strong understanding of customer challenges and solution development
- Expert presentation and communication skills with ability to engage stakeholders
- Proven experience in consultative selling and/or hardware equipment sales are a plus
- Ability to travel up to 60% within assigned territory
- Experience with CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications
- Fluent English language is required; German and/or French is a plus
- Valid driver's license

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Forniamo ai nostri team globali le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, aiutando a superare la scienza, sviluppando soluzioni per alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, come proteggere l’ambiente, assicurarsi che il nostro cibo sia sicuro o aiutando a trovare cure per il cancro.

## Posizione Riepilogo:

Il Senior Technical Sales Specialist (TSS) per Single-Use Technologies è un ruolo nell'organizzazione di vendita del Gruppo BioProduction. Questo ruolo gestirà attivamente le opportunità di imbuto per i guadagni di reddito a breve termine e svilupperà nuove opportunità per costruire una pipeline forte per la crescita futura, mantenendo le relazioni commerciali attuali e la crescita organica. Questo individuo applicherà la loro esperienza di vendita, la conoscenza del bioprocesso, la competenza del prodotto, l'intelligenza di mercato e le capacità di leadership del territorio per aumentare le vendite e la redditività.

## Responsabilità chiave:

- Cerca nuove opportunità e utilizza il portafoglio prodotti per costruire una base per la crescita a lungo termine
- Guida imbuto esistente di opportunità per accelerare i tassi di chiusura
- Riguarda la ricerca basata sull'intelligenza per identificare nuove opportunità potenziali
- Prioritizza le nuove prospettive di introduzione del prodotto (NPI) all'interno del territorio per migliorare i tassi di adozione e il ritorno dei ricavi
- Atti sul marketing-qualificato conduce, rapidamente convertendo a nuove opportunità
- Collabora con e influenza Bioproduzione Account Manager (BAM) e Field Application Scientists (FAS) all'interno del loro distretto per sviluppare e condurre strategie di crescita account
- Assiste tutti gli Account Manager di BioProduction all'interno del territorio assegnato con gli sforzi di pianificazione delle vendite e degli account per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita
- Aiuti allo sviluppo di soluzioni tecniche-matching per opportunità complesse
- Mantiene e migliora la conoscenza tecnica sulle linee di prodotto assegnate, sulla letteratura aziendale e sui prodotti pilotati

## Requisiti minimi/qualificazioni:

- Corso di laurea in un campo legato alla vita-scienza richiesto, come Biologia, Biologia Molecolare, Microbiologia, Immunologia, Biochimica, Biotecnologia, o Ingegneria
- 7+ anni di vendite combinate o di esperienza funzionale adiacente che lavorano in un ruolo legato al processo di bioproduzione. Uso singolo preferito
- Capacità dimostrata di collaborare tra funzioni e dipartimenti
- Comprensione tecnica dei flussi di lavoro e delle applicazioni di bioproduzione
- Mostra buon giudizio e tatto quando si tratta di clienti interni ed esterni
- Deve possedere una forte comprensione delle sfide del cliente e dello sviluppo della soluzione
- Competenze di presentazione e comunicazione con capacità di coinvolgere gli stakeholder
- Esperienza comprovata nella vendita consulenziale e/o nella vendita di attrezzature hardware
- Capacità di viaggiare fino al 60% all'interno del territorio assegnato
- Esperienza con sistemi CRM e applicazioni Microsoft Office
- È richiesta una lingua inglese fluida; il tedesco e/o il francese è un plus
- Patente di guida valida

- 7+ Jahre kombinierter Verkauf oder angrenzende Funktionserfahrung in einer Rolle im Zusammenhang mit dem Bioproduktionsprozess. Einmaliger Gebrauch bevorzugt

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Location/Division Specific Information:

This position is part of the Microbiological Quality Control (MBQC) team from Thermo Fisher Scientific in Lengnau (CH), supporting GMP-regulated manufacturing operations. The role operates within a laboratory environment focused on ensuring microbiological quality and compliance of pharmaceutical products and processes.

## A Day in the Life:

- Coordinate and work on the transfer, development and validation of analytical methods including qualification of equipment needed for analysis.
- Actively contribute to the GMP Inspection Readiness of QC to ensure the fully compliance of relevant Quality System and Procedural documents.
- Actively contribute to the QC operational readiness managing projects (external and internal) and the assigned to ressources (including coordination of people daily tasks). Participates in the transfer, development and validation of analytical methods including qualification of equipment needed for analysis.
- Responsible for development, transfer and validation of analytical procedures professionally and according to timelines.
- Ensure ready to state activities in the MBQC lab.
- Collaboration in the solution of MBQC problematic and / or questions (quality problems, government inquiries, etc.).
- Supporting of laboratory employee during troubleshooting activities.
- Efficient communication: Informing the MBQC head in a timely manner regarding ongoing business activities, deviations, and problems within the team.
- Responsible for writing and revision of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and instructions (Wis) professionally and according to timelines.
- Responsible for SME review and approval of methods, plans, protocols and reports, gap assessments

## Education & Experience:

- Degree (Master or higher) in the Microbiology or Life Science Area
- At least 5 years experience in microbiological laboratories including experience in a regulated GMP environment.

## Knowledge, Abilities:

- Extensive knowledge of microbiological testing techniques (bioburden, endotoxin, qPCR) and laboratory best practices
- Strong knowledge of cGMP requirements, method validation/verification, and documentation standards (SOPs, WIs)
- Ability to troubleshoot microbiological issues, support investigations, and collaborate in cross-functional teams
- Fluent English (written and spoken), German is a plus

## What We Offer:

- Compensation
- Competitive Pay
- Performance Related Bonus where eligible
- Annual merit performance-based increase

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Condizioni ambientali

Aderenza a tutte le buone pratiche di fabbricazione (GMP) standard di sicurezza

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Forniamo ai nostri team globali le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, aiutando a superare la scienza, sviluppando soluzioni per alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, come proteggere l’ambiente, assicurarsi che il nostro cibo sia sicuro o aiutando a trovare cure per il cancro.

## Location/Division Informazioni specifiche:

Questa posizione fa parte del team Microbiological Quality Control (MBQC) di Thermo Fisher Scientific in Lengnau (CH), che supporta le operazioni di produzione regolate da GMP. Il ruolo opera all'interno di un ambiente di laboratorio mirato a garantire la qualità microbiologica e la conformità dei prodotti e processi farmaceutici.

## Un giorno nella vita:

- Coordinare e lavorare sul trasferimento, lo sviluppo e la convalida di metodi analitici, tra cui la qualificazione di attrezzature necessarie per l'analisi.
- Contribuire attivamente alla disponibilità di controllo GMP di QC per garantire la piena conformità del relativo sistema di qualità e documenti procedurali.
- Contribuire attivamente ai progetti di gestione della disponibilità operativa QC (esterno e interno) e alle risorse assegnate (compreso il coordinamento delle attività quotidiane delle persone). Partecipa al trasferimento, allo sviluppo e alla convalida di metodi analitici, tra cui la qualificazione di attrezzature necessarie per l'analisi.
- Responsabile per lo sviluppo, il trasferimento e la validazione di procedure analitiche professionalmente e secondo tempi.
- Assicurarsi di essere pronti a svolgere attività nel laboratorio MBQC.
- Collaborazione nella soluzione di MBQC problematico e / o domande (problemi di qualità, indagini governative, ecc.).
- Supporto dei dipendenti di laboratorio durante le attività di risoluzione dei problemi.
- Comunicazione efficiente: Informare la testa di MBQC in modo tempestivo sulle attività aziendali in corso, deviazioni e problemi all'interno del team.
- Responsabile per la scrittura e la revisione delle procedure operative standard (SOP) e istruzioni (Wis) professionalmente e secondo tempi.
- Responsabile per la revisione e l'approvazione delle PMI di metodi, piani, protocolli e relazioni, valutazioni dei gap

## Istruzione e esperienza:

- Laurea (Master o superiore) in Microbiologia o Life Science Area
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in laboratori microbiologici tra cui l'esperienza in un ambiente GMP regolamentato.

## Conoscenza, abilità:

- Ampia conoscenza delle tecniche di test microbiologici (bioburden, endotossina, qPCR) e delle best practice di laboratorio
- Forte conoscenza dei requisiti cGMP, convalida dei metodi/verificazione e standard di documentazione (SOP, WIs)
- Capacità di risolvere problemi microbiologici, di sostenere le indagini e di collaborare in team interfunzionali
- Inglese fluente (scritto e parlato), tedesco è un plus

## Cosa offriamo:

- Compensazione
- Paga competitiva
- Prestazioni Bonus Correlato dove idoneo
- Aumento basato sulle prestazioni del merito annuale

## Arbeitsplan

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Umweltbedingungen

Einhaltung aller Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Sicherheitsstandards

## Stellenbeschreibung

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kollegen erwecken wir unsere Mission jeden Tag zum Leben, damit unsere Kunden die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer machen können. Wir stellen unseren globalen Teams die Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um individuelle Karriereziele zu erreichen, und helfen gleichzeitig, die Wissenschaft einen Schritt weiter zu bringen, indem wir Lösungen für einige der schwierigsten Herausforderungen der Welt entwickeln, wie den Schutz der Umwelt, die Gewährleistung der Sicherheit unserer Lebensmittel oder die Suche nach Heilmitteln für Krebs.

## Standort/Bereichsspezifische Angaben:

Diese Position ist Teil des Teams für mikrobiologische Qualitätskontrolle (MBQC) von Thermo Fisher Scientific in Lengnau (CH), das GMP-regulierte Fertigungsbetriebe unterstützt. Die Rolle spielt sich in einer Laborumgebung ab, die sich auf die Gewährleistung der mikrobiologischen Qualität und der Konformität pharmazeutischer Produkte und Prozesse konzentriert.

## Ein Tag im Leben:

- Koordination und Arbeit an der Übertragung, Entwicklung und Validierung von Analysemethoden, einschließlich der Qualifizierung der für die Analyse benötigten Ausrüstung.
- Aktiver Beitrag zur GMP Inspection Readiness von QC, um die vollständige Einhaltung der relevanten Qualitätssicherungssysteme und Verfahrensunterlagen sicherzustellen.
- Aktiver Beitrag zur QC-Operational Readiness Management-Projekte (extern und intern) und die zugewiesenen Ressourcen (einschließlich der Koordination der täglichen Aufgaben der Menschen). Beteiligt sich an der Übertragung, Entwicklung und Validierung von Analysemethoden, einschließlich der Qualifizierung der für die Analyse benötigten Ausrüstung.
- Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung, Übertragung und Validierung von analytischen Verfahren professionell und nach Zeitvorgaben.
- Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie bereit sind, Aktivitäten im MBQC-Labor anzugeben.
- Zusammenarbeit bei der Lösung von MBQC-Problemen und / oder Fragen (Qualitätsprobleme, Regierungsanfragen usw.).
- Unterstützung von Labormitarbeitern bei der Fehlersuche.
- Effiziente Kommunikation: rechtzeitige Information des MBQC-Leiters über laufende Geschäftsaktivitäten, Abweichungen und Probleme im Team.
- Verantwortlich für das Schreiben und die Überarbeitung von Standard-Betriebsanweisungen (SOPs) und Anweisungen (Wis) professionell und nach Zeitvorgaben.
- Verantwortlich für die KMU-Überprüfung und Genehmigung von Methoden, Plänen, Protokollen und Berichten, Lückenbewertungen

## Bildung & Erfahrung:

- Grad (Master oder höher) in der Mikrobiologie oder Life Science Area
- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in mikrobiologischen Labors, einschließlich Erfahrung in einer regulierten GMP-Umgebung.

## Wissen, Fähigkeiten:

- Umfangreiche Kenntnisse über mikrobiologische Testverfahren (Bioburden, Endotoxin, qPCR) und bewährte Laborverfahren
- Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der cGMP-Anforderungen, Methodenvalidierung/-verifizierung und Dokumentationsstandards (SOPs, WIs)
- Fähigkeit, mikrobiologische Probleme zu beheben, Untersuchungen zu unterstützen und in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten
- fließendes Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen), Deutsch ist ein Plus

## Was wir anbieten:

- Ausgleich
- Wettbewerbsfähiges Entgelt
- Leistungsbezogener Bonus, sofern zulässig
- Jährliche leistungsbasierte Steigerung

jobs.title: R&D Engineer
jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard Office Hours (40/wk)

## Environmental Conditions

Laboratory Setting, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Description

Join our innovative R&D team at the Cheseaux site, specializing in Optical Emission and XRF-XRD Spectroscopy, to make a meaningful impact on scientific advancement, working on sophisticated projects that directly impact product development and customer success. As an R&D Engineer, you will play an important role in the development of next generation of products, and new applications for Spark Optical Emission spectrometers. You will actively participate to the life cycle of the instruments and applications, by sustaining our internal/external customers when a deep analytical knowledge is requested.

## Responsibilities

- Participate in development of new product and technology concepts and specifications with multidisciplinary teams
- Participate in testing, validation and optimization of new products and technologies in collaboration with other R&D functions
- Develop new applications for existing and new instruments, and provide all the necessary technical information and documentation to Operations, Service and Marketing teams
- Design, execute experiments and analyze the resulting data to resolve technical challenges
- Demonstrate leadership and willingness for continuous improvement
- Once experienced, lead one workstream of an innovative technical project
- Provide analytical support for existing products and applications, to Operations, Service, Marketing, Sales, and Customers, when a deep analytical expertise and a perfect knowledge of the instruments is required
- Mentor colleagues (as new hired or less experienced colleagues)

## Requirements

- PhD or equivalent degree, plus minimum 3 years of cumulative technical experience
- Preferred fields of study: chemistry, physics, material science, geology or related discipline
- Demonstrated expertise in laboratory techniques and instrumentation, ideally with spectroscopic techniques and solid-state image sensors (CCD, CMOS, CID, etc.)
- Proven experience in problem solving, analytical skills and technical troubleshooting skills, with ability to design experiments and interpret complex data
- Proficiency with relevant software and data analysis tools (such as advanced Excel and macros, Python, Matlab, etc.), and good knowledge of statistics. Knowledge of AI tools is a plus
- Excellent organizational and time management skills to handle multiple tasks
- Excellent documentation skills
- Strong written and verbal communication abilities to present technical information to diverse audiences
- Experience leading technical projects, and ideally mentoring colleagues
- Proficient in English, knowledge of French is a plus
- Knowledge in metallurgy is a plus
- May require travel <20%

This job description does not describe all the duties, tasks and responsibilities which need to be performed in the function. Any other job-related instructions, duties, tasks or responsibilities which are requested by the team leader or manager are required to follow.

As for any job in the company, it is requested to observe, apply with common sense, and promote the best practices related to Quality, Customer Orientation, Safety, Health, and Environment, and to report gaps, deviations, and dangerous situations.

Nell'ambito del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. ## Designazione

Unisciti al nostro innovativo team R&D presso il sito Cheseaux, specializzato in Optical Emission e XRF-XRD Spectroscopy, per avere un impatto significativo sull'avanzamento scientifico, lavorando su progetti sofisticati che influiscono direttamente sullo sviluppo del prodotto e sul successo del cliente. Come Ingegnere R&D, si svolgerà un ruolo importante nello sviluppo di prossima generazione di prodotti, e nuove applicazioni per spettrometri Spark Optical Emission. Parteciperete attivamente al ciclo di vita degli strumenti e delle applicazioni, sostenendo i nostri clienti interni/esterni quando viene richiesta una profonda conoscenza analitica.

- Partecipa allo sviluppo di nuovi concetti e specifiche di prodotto e tecnologia con team multidisciplinari
- Partecipa a test, validazione e ottimizzazione di nuovi prodotti e tecnologie in collaborazione con altre funzioni R&D
- Sviluppare nuove applicazioni per strumenti esistenti e nuovi e fornire tutte le informazioni tecniche e la documentazione necessarie ai team Operazioni, Servizio e Marketing
- Progettare, eseguire esperimenti e analizzare i dati risultante per risolvere le sfide tecniche
- Dimostrare leadership e disponibilità per un miglioramento continuo
- Una volta sperimentato, guidare un workstream di un progetto tecnico innovativo
- Fornire supporto analitico per i prodotti e le applicazioni esistenti, per le operazioni, il servizio, il marketing, le vendite e i clienti, quando è necessaria una profonda esperienza analitica e una perfetta conoscenza degli strumenti
- colleghi mentori (come nuovi colleghi assunti o meno esperti)

## Requisiti

- PhD o grado equivalente, più minimo 3 anni di esperienza tecnica cumulativa
- Campi di studio preferiti: chimica, fisica, scienza materiale, geologia o disciplina relativa
- Competenza dimostrata nelle tecniche di laboratorio e nella strumentazione, idealmente con tecniche spettroscopiche e sensori di immagine a stato solido (CCD, CMOS, CID, ecc.)
- Esperienza comprovata nella risoluzione dei problemi, abilità analitiche e capacità di risoluzione dei problemi tecnici, con la capacità di progettare esperimenti e interpretare dati complessi
- Competenza con strumenti di analisi di software e dati rilevanti (come Excel avanzato e macro, Python, Matlab, ecc.), e buona conoscenza delle statistiche. La conoscenza degli strumenti AI è un plus
- Eccellente capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo per gestire più attività
- Capacità di documentazione eccellente
- Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale per presentare informazioni tecniche a diversi pubblico
- Esperienza di progetti tecnici leader, e idealmente mentoring colleghi
- Proficiente in inglese, la conoscenza del francese è un plus
- La conoscenza della metallurgia è un plus
- Può richiedere viaggi <20%

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. - Ausgezeichnete Organisations- und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten zur Bewältigung mehrerer Aufgaben
- Hervorragende Dokumentationsfähigkeiten
- Starke schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um technische Informationen einem unterschiedlichen Publikum zu präsentieren
- Erleben Sie leitende technische Projekte und betreuen Sie idealerweise Kollegen
- Englischkenntnisse, Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus
- Wissen in der Metallurgie ist ein Plus
- Kann Reisen erfordern <20%

- Domaines d'études privilégiés : chimie, physique, sciences des matériaux, géologie ou discipline connexe
- Expertise démontrée dans les techniques de laboratoire et l'instrumentation, idéalement avec les techniques spectroscopiques et les capteurs d'images à l'état solide (CCD, CMOS, CID, etc.)

- Connaissance des logiciels et des outils d'analyse des données (tels que Excel et macros avancés, Python, Matlab, etc.) et bonne connaissance des statistiques. La connaissance des outils d'IA est un plus
- Excellentes compétences en gestion de l'organisation et du temps pour gérer plusieurs tâches
- Excellentes compétences en documentation
- Forte capacité de communication écrite et verbale pour présenter de l'information technique à divers publics
- Expérience de projets techniques de premier plan, et idéalement encadrement de collègues

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

We are looking for a Laboratory Specialist – Sample Management to join our Quality Control (QC) team. In this role, you will play a key part in coordinating the full lifecycle of samples and supporting laboratory operations in a regulated GMP environment.

## Laboratory Specialist Sample Management

## Key Responsibilities:

- Manage the end-to-end sample lifecycle, including receipt, inspection, LIMS registration, aliquoting, storage, distribution, shipment, and final disposition
- Ensure proper chain of custody, tracking, and documentation for all samples in compliance with GMP and internal procedures
- Perform sampling activities for raw materials, plant utilities, clean utilities, environmental monitoring, and cleaning validation
- Coordinate and support sampling activities at external warehouses (3PL) and manage interactions with third-party laboratories
- Support QC laboratory operations, including preparation, testing activities, and general lab maintenance (equipment, waste management, cleanliness)
- Assist in testing raw materials, in-process samples, intermediates, and finished products, as well as microbiological analyses (bioburden, endotoxin, PCR)
- Organize and oversee sample logistics, including storage conditions, inventory, shipment, and timely delivery to internal and external stakeholders
- Maintain accurate and compliant documentation within LIMS and other systems, ensuring data integrity at all times
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, providing clear communication on sample status and supporting daily operational meetings
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, including optimization of sampling processes and updating SOPs/work instructions
- Ensure strict adherence to GMP, GLP, quality standards, and safety regulations, actively supporting quality and EHSS initiatives

## Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences (Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry), OR
- Laboratory apprenticeship or equivalent experience with strong industry background

Experience

- Minimum 2 years of laboratory experience, preferably in a GMP-regulated environment
- Proven ability to work independently and maintain accurate documentation

Skills & Competencies

- Strong organizational and communication skills
- Detail-oriented, precise, and reliable
- Customer-focused mindset with strong teamwork skills
- Good English language skills
- Good knowledge in Microsoft Office, SAP, and LIMS

- Gestire il ciclo di vita campione end-to-end, tra cui ricevuta, ispezione, registrazione LIMS, aliquoting, stoccaggio, distribuzione, spedizione e disposizione finale
- Assicurare una corretta catena di custodia, monitoraggio e documentazione per tutti i campioni in conformità con GMP e procedure interne
- Eseguire le attività di campionamento per materie prime, utenze vegetali, utilità pulite, monitoraggio ambientale e validazione delle pulizie
- Coordinare e sostenere le attività di campionamento presso i magazzini esterni (3PL) e gestire le interazioni con i laboratori di terze parti
- Supporta le operazioni di laboratorio QC, comprese le attività di preparazione, test e manutenzione generale del laboratorio (attrezzatura, gestione dei rifiuti, pulizia)
- Assistere nella sperimentazione di materie prime, campioni di processo, intermedi e prodotti finiti, nonché analisi microbiologiche (bioburden, endotossina, PCR)
- Organizzare e supervisionare la logistica dei campioni, comprese le condizioni di archiviazione, l'inventario, la spedizione e la consegna tempestiva agli stakeholder interni ed esterni
- Mantenere la documentazione accurata e conforme all'interno di LIMS e altri sistemi, garantendo l'integrità dei dati in ogni momento
- Collabora con i team interfunzionali, fornendo una chiara comunicazione sullo stato del campione e sostenendo le riunioni operative quotidiane
- Contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo, compresa l'ottimizzazione dei processi di campionamento e l'aggiornamento delle istruzioni SOP/lavoro
- Garantire una stretta adesione a GMP, GLP, standard di qualità e norme di sicurezza, sostenendo attivamente le iniziative di qualità e EHSS

Istruzione

- Laurea in Scienze della vita (Chimica, Biologia, Biochimica), O
- Apprendistato di laboratorio o esperienza equivalente con forte background industriale

Esperienza

- Minimo 2 anni di esperienza di laboratorio, preferibilmente in ambiente GMP-regolato
- Prova capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e mantenere la documentazione accurata

Competenze e competenze

- Forte capacità organizzative e di comunicazione
- Dettaglio, preciso e affidabile
- Mindset focalizzato sul cliente con forti competenze di lavoro di squadra
- Buone competenze linguistiche
- Buona conoscenza in Microsoft Office, SAP e LIMS

Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la coordination du cycle de vie complet des échantillons et dans les opérations de laboratoire dans un environnement de BPF réglementé.

## Spécialiste de laboratoire Gestion des échantillons

## Principales responsabilités :

- Gérer le cycle de vie des échantillons de bout en bout, y compris la réception, l'inspection, l'enregistrement du SGLI, l'aliquation, l'entreposage, la distribution, l'expédition et la disposition finale
- Assurer une chaîne adéquate de garde, de suivi et de documentation pour tous les échantillons conformément aux BPF et aux procédures internes
- Effectuer des activités d'échantillonnage pour les matières premières, les installations, les installations propres, la surveillance de l'environnement et la validation du nettoyage
- Coordonner et appuyer les activités d'échantillonnage dans les entrepôts externes (3PL) et gérer les interactions avec des laboratoires tiers
- Soutenir les opérations de laboratoire de QC, y compris la préparation, les activités d'essai et l'entretien général des laboratoires (équipement, gestion des déchets, propreté)
- Aider à tester les matières premières, les échantillons en cours de fabrication, les produits intermédiaires et les produits finis, ainsi que les analyses microbiologiques (biocharge, endotoxine, PCR)
- Organiser et superviser l'échantillonnage logistique, y compris les conditions d'entreposage, l'inventaire, l'expédition et la livraison en temps opportun aux intervenants internes et externes
- Tenir à jour une documentation précise et conforme dans le SGIL et d'autres systèmes, en assurant l'intégrité des données en tout temps
- Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, fournir une communication claire sur l'état des échantillons et appuyer les réunions opérationnelles quotidiennes
- Contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration continue, y compris l'optimisation des processus d'échantillonnage et la mise à jour des SOP/instructions de travail
- Assurer le strict respect des BPF, des BPL, des normes de qualité et des règlements de sécurité, soutenir activement les initiatives en matière de qualité et de SSE

## Compétences

Éducation

- Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie (chimie, biologie, biochimie), OR
- Apprentissage en laboratoire ou expérience équivalente avec un solide bagage industriel

Expérience

- Au moins 2 ans d'expérience en laboratoire, de préférence dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF
- Capacité éprouvée de travailler de façon indépendante et de conserver une documentation précise

Compétences

- Compétences solides en matière d ' organisation et de communication
- Des détails, précis et fiables
- Un état d'esprit axé sur le client et de solides compétences en travail d'équipe
- Bonnes compétences en anglais
- Bonne connaissance de Microsoft Office, SAP et LIMS

jobs.title: DSP Manufacturing Team Leader
jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Rotational shift nights/weekends

## Environmental Conditions

Able to lift 40 lbs. without assistance, Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our colleagues bring our Mission to life every day, enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We support our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while advancing solutions to some of the world’s toughest challenges—from protecting the environment to ensuring food safety and developing life-saving therapies.

## Position Summary

Join our dynamic team at Thermo Fisher Scientific as the Team Leader for DSP Manufacturing, where you'll lead a skilled team of professionals in our pioneering facility in Lengnau.You will ensure operational readiness, compliance, and efficient execution of manufacturing processes while driving continuous improvement and supporting new product introductions.This role combines technical expertise with people leadership to deliver high-quality pharmaceutical and biotechnology products.

## Key Responsibilities

- Lead and support the **day-to-day execution** of manufacturing operations in compliance with cGMP requirements
- Manage, coach, and develop a team of operators to ensure high performance and engagement
- Own and maintain **Work Instructions and SOPs**, ensuring they are up to date and followed
- Support **Technology Transfer** of new products and contribute to CVQ, PQ, and Process Validation activities
- Participate in **New Product Introduction (NPI)** activities
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Quality, Engineering, PCS, Maintenance) to resolve issues and improve processes
- Drive **Manufacturing Excellence** initiatives to ensure robust and efficient operations
- Support the definition and optimization of **process parameters** during routine manufacturing campaigns
- Ensure compliance with **safety, quality, and regulatory requirements**
- Lead or support **investigations, deviations, and change controls** as required

## Qualifications & Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Engineering, or a related field
- Minimum 2 years of experience in pharmaceutical/biotechnology manufacturing in a cGMP environment
- Strong knowledge of **cGMP and regulatory requirements**
- Proven ability to **lead, coach, and develop teams**
- Strong **technical troubleshooting** and problem-solving skills
- Experience with **process validation, technology transfer, and manufacturing systems**
- Knowledge of **Lean principles and continuous improvement methodologies** is a plus
- Excellent **communication and organizational skills**
- Experience with **documentation, deviations, and change control systems**
- Ability to work in a **cleanroom environment** and follow aseptic practices
- Flexibility to work shifts, including weekends if required

## What We Offer

- A dynamic and innovative work environment
- Opportunities for career development and growth
- The chance to contribute to life-saving therapies and global health improvements
