## Programma di lavoro

Settimane di turno/settimana

## Condizioni ambientali

In grado di sollevare 40 lbs. senza assistenza, Aderenza a tutte le Buone pratiche di fabbricazione (GMP) Standard di sicurezza, Cleanroom: nessun prodotti per capelli, gioielli, trucco, smalto, profumo, piercing a vista, capelli facciali ecc... consentiti, Cold Room/Freezers -22gradsF/-6grads C, Qualche grado di PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) richiesto (vetri di sicurezza, camice, guanti da laboratorio, vestiario, guanti

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. I nostri colleghi portano la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno, consentendo ai clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e più sicuro. Sosteniamo i nostri team con le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, promuovendo soluzioni ad alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, proteggendo l’ambiente per garantire la sicurezza alimentare e sviluppare terapie salvavita.

## Posizione Sommario

Unisciti al nostro team dinamico presso Thermo Fisher Scientific come Team Leader per la DSP Manufacturing, dove guiderai un team di professionisti esperti nella nostra struttura pionieristica di Lengnau. Garantirete la prontezza operativa, la conformità e l'esecuzione efficiente dei processi produttivi, mentre guidate il miglioramento continuo e supportate le nuove introduzioni dei prodotti. Questo ruolo combina competenze tecniche con la leadership delle persone per fornire prodotti farmaceutici e biotecnologie di alta qualità.

## Principali responsabilità

- Guidare e sostenere l'esecuzione giorno per giorno delle operazioni di produzione in conformità ai requisiti cGMP
- Gestire, allenare e sviluppare un team di operatori per garantire elevate prestazioni e impegno
- Possedere e mantenere Istruzioni di lavoro e SOP, assicurandosi che siano aggiornati e seguiti
- Supporto Trasferimento Tecnologico di nuovi prodotti e contribuire a CVQ, PQ e attività di convalida dei processi
- Partecipazione a Nuova introduzione del prodotto (NPI) attività
- Collaborare con team interfunzionali (Qualità, Ingegneria, PCS, Manutenzione) per risolvere i problemi e migliorare i processi
- Guidare Manufacturing Excellence iniziative per garantire operazioni robuste ed efficienti
- Supporta la definizione e l'ottimizzazione dei parametri process durante le campagne di produzione di routine
- Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti di sicurezza, qualità e regolamentazione
- Guidare o sostenere indagini, deviazioni e controlli di cambiamento come richiesto

## Qualifiche e requisiti

- Laurea (o superiore) in Chimica, Biochimica, Biologia, Ingegneria, o un campo relativo
- Minimo 2 anni di esperienza nella produzione farmaceutica/biotecnica in un ambiente cGMP
- Forte conoscenza di cGMP e requisiti normativi
- Prove capacità di gestire, allenare e sviluppare team
- Robuste capacità di risoluzione dei problemi tecnici e di risoluzione dei problemi
- Esperienza con process validazione, trasferimento tecnologico e sistemi di produzione
- La conoscenza di Principi lievi e metodologie di miglioramento continuo è un plus
- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e di organizzazione
- Esperienza con documentazione, deviazioni e sistemi di controllo dei cambiamenti
- Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito e seguire pratiche asettiche
- Flessibilità ai turni di lavoro, compresi i fine settimana, se necessario

## Cosa offriamo

- Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e innovativo
- Opportunità per lo sviluppo e la crescita della carriera
- La possibilità di contribuire a terapie salvavita e miglioramenti globali della salute

Fähig, 40 lbs. ohne Hilfe zu heben, Einhaltung aller Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Sicherheitsstandards, Reinraum: keine Haarprodukte, Schmuck, Make-up, Nagellack, Parfüm, exponierte Piercings, Gesichtsbehaarung usw ... erlaubt, Cold Room / Gefrierschränke -22 Grad F /-6 Grad C, Ein gewisses Maß an PPE (persönliche Schutzausrüstung) erforderlich (Sicherheitsbrille, Kleid, Handschuhe, Laborkittel, Ohrstöpsel usw.)

- Führen und unterstützen Sie die ** tägliche Ausführung ** von Fertigungsvorgängen in Übereinstimmung mit den cGMP-Anforderungen

- Förderung von **Manufacturing Excellence**-Initiativen zur Gewährleistung eines robusten und effizienten Betriebs
- Unterstützung der Definition und Optimierung von **Prozessparametern** während routinemäßiger Fertigungskampagnen
- Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der **Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und regulatorischen Anforderungen**
- Führen oder Unterstützen **Untersuchungen, Abweichungen und Änderungskontrollen ** nach Bedarf

## Qualifikationen & Anforderungen

- Bachelor-Abschluss (oder höher) in Chemie, Biochemie, Biologie, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich
- Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen / Biotechnologie-Fertigung in einer cGMP-Umgebung
- Starkes Wissen über **cGMP und regulatorische Anforderungen **
- Bewährte Fähigkeit, Teams zu führen, zu trainieren und zu entwickeln

- Erfahrung mit **Prozessvalidierung, Technologietransfer und Fertigungssystemen**
- Kenntnis von **Lean-Prinzipien und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden ** ist ein Plus
- Hervorragende **Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten**
- Erfahrung mit ** Dokumentation, Abweichungen und Change Control Systemen**
- Fähigkeit, in einer ** Reinraumumgebung** zu arbeiten und aseptische Praktiken zu befolgen
- Flexibilität für Arbeitsschichten, einschließlich Wochenenden, falls erforderlich

## Was wir anbieten

- Ein dynamisches und innovatives Arbeitsumfeld
- Möglichkeiten für Karriereentwicklung und Wachstum
- Die Chance, zu lebensrettenden Therapien und globalen Gesundheitsverbesserungen beizutragen

jobs.title: On-site Service Engineer (Chromatography) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Laboratory Setting, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.), Will work with hazardous/toxic materials

## Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, increasing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our global team of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

When you’re part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll do exciting work, and join a team that values performance, quality and innovation. As part of a successful, growing global organization you will be encouraged to perform at your best. With revenues of more than $40 billion and the largest investment in R&D in the industry, we give our people the resources and chances to create meaningful contributions to the world. Unity Lab Services, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, provides critical on-site instrument services at customer locations. Our colleagues are passionate about improving customer experience and service operations efficiency.

For the support of our Team we are looking for a

## On-Site Service Engineer (Chromatography) (f/m/d)

## Discover Impactful Work

This is an excellent opportunity to start your career in our growing Field Service team and make a difference - you will receive comprehensive training from our colleagues to get you started with your development within Thermo Fisher Scientific.

Focus of the role is Installation, Preventive Maintenance, Instrument Qualification and Troubleshooting of Chromatographic (HPLC / IC) Devices.

## Responsibilities

- Collaborate with colleagues in our customer care center to efficiently schedule your service visits to meet and exceed customer expectations.
- Install our products from our diverse Chromatography portfolio, demonstrate instrument specification and instruct customers on use (Familiarization)
- Perform preventive maintenance and qualifications on customer instruments and help to improve instrument uptime and availability.
- Detailed preparation and documentation of maintenance and qualification activities to meet regulatory requirements.
- Analysis of instrument failures
- Contributes to the overall Service Targets with respect to Bookings, Revenues, Service Profit and Overhead Cost while following all internal rules, processes and practices (as they are described)
- Performs all Service Activities in line with internal rules and customer regulations
- Always ensure the highest professional relationship with our customer base to achieve customer loyalty and raise issues if necessary, to solve critical tasks in the fastest way possible
- Follow our ethical business conduct guidance.
- Manage the company's assets provided, such as Car Stock/Inventory of Parts, Computer, Telephone, general Tools, Software, Company Car, Manuals etc.
- Optimize the own work schedule by coordinating with all the vital partners for service planning/scheduling (Dispatching function, Team Leader, others).

## Minimum Qualifications

- Curiosity about analytical instruments, systems, applications, new products and technologies.
- Technical education or chemical background
- Proficient in German and good knowledge of English language
- Driving license
- Excellent inter-personal, self-motivational and negotiating skills
- Open to travel for training or special calls, international including all EMEA Territory and the US is required.

## Preferred Qualifications

- 2-3 years’ experience servicing of our Chromatography products or as a user
- Good hardware and software skills especially of Windows operating systems and applications as well as Microsoft Office package
- Strong problem solving skills
- Proven organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks with different priorities

**We are offering** an employment with an innovative and growing organization with outstanding career and development prospects and an exciting company culture which stands for integrity, intensity and innovation. The role comes with a competitive salary plan, company car and further employee benefits.

**If you are interested**, please apply online with your CV and Motivation Letter including possible start date and salary expectations.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, each one of our 100,000 extraordinary minds has a unique story to tell. Join us and contribute to our singular mission—enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or any other legally protected status.

**Apply today!**[http://jobs.thermofisher.com](http://jobs.thermofisher.com)

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to advancing clinical research. As a Client Services Project Manager I, you'll support clinical trials by managing project documentation, coordinating supply chain activities, and ensuring consistent delivery of services. Work closely with internal teams and clients to support study success while maintaining the highest quality standards. You'll handle project planning, documentation management, and cross-functional coordination to meet timelines and client expectations.

• Bachelor's degree required, no prior experience required, preferably in clinical trials or pharmaceutical industry
• Preferred Fields of Study: healthcare, supply chain management, life sciences, or related field

• Demonstrated project management skills with ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Project
• Experience with enterprise systems like Salesforce, GPMS, and TrackWise preferred
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and documentation abilities
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams

• Experience coordinating with teams and managing stakeholder relationships
• Ability to analyze data and generate clear, accurate reports
• Focus on quality service and continuous improvement
• Adaptable to changing priorities while maintaining attention to detail
• Travel to client sites or other facilities may be required

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. Description: Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Lead QC Technician, where you'll help make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. In this important role, you'll ensure quality standards are met through testing and inspection of products in a cGMP environment. You'll coordinate quality control activities, lead a team of QC technicians, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain the highest quality standards. You'll perform analytical testing, document results, and support continuous improvement initiatives while mentoring team members.

Responsibilities :

- Responsible for the organization of daily operations in the Microbiological QC (MBQC) laboratory and to maintain the laboratory operational (incl. maintenance of equipment).
- Responsible for the creation and revision of guidance documents such as SOPs/Wls and other related documents.
- System Matter Expert (SME) for Bioburden, Growth Promotion, Micro Identifications and Endotoxin testing method and related quality events.
- Participates in the transfer, development and verification/validation of microbiological methods including qualification of equipment needed for analysis.
- Testing of final and intermediate products, in process samples, samples from cleaning validation, utilities and environmental monitoring samples as back up.
- Supports the GMP Inspection Readiness of QC to ensure the fully compliance of relevant Quality System and Procedural documents.
- Supports of the QC teams (MBQC and Service and Support) in the ordering of material, logistic of samples and inventory management of the QC labs.
- Acts as Biosafety officer at the Thermo Fisher Scientific Lengnau site in accordance with the Swiss law (SAMV, ESV).

Requirements:

- Minimum 4 years of experience in quality control within a regulated environment (pharmaceutical/medical device preferred)
- Preferred Fields of Study: Chemistry, Biology, or related scientific field
- Demonstrated proficiency with analytical testing equipment and techniques (HPLC, GC, spectrophotometry)
- Strong understanding of cGMP requirements and quality systems
- Experience with quality documentation and data review
- Proven ability to lead and mentor others while maintaining quality standards
- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
- Strong verbal and written communication abilities
- Proficiency with standard office software and LIMS systems
- Ability to work in cleanroom environments and follow gowning procedures
- Physical ability to stand for extended periods, lift up to 25 lbs occasionally
- Flexibility to work various shifts as needed
- Problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot technical issues
- Experience writing and reviewing SOPs and technical documentation

Aderenza a tutte le buone pratiche di fabbricazione (GMP) standard di sicurezza

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Forniamo ai nostri team globali le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, aiutando a superare la scienza, sviluppando soluzioni per alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, come proteggere l’ambiente, assicurarsi che il nostro cibo sia sicuro o aiutando a trovare cure per il cancro. Descrizione: Unisciti al nostro team di Thermo Fisher Scientific come Lead QC Technician, dove potrai aiutare a rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. In questo ruolo importante, ti assicurerai che gli standard di qualità vengano rispettati attraverso test e ispezione dei prodotti in un ambiente cGMP. Coordinerai le attività di controllo della qualità, guiderai un team di tecnici QC e collaborerai con team interfunzionali per mantenere i più elevati standard di qualità. Potrai eseguire test analitici, risultati dei documenti e sostenere iniziative di miglioramento continuo mentre tutor i membri del team.

Responsabile:

- Responsabile per l'organizzazione di operazioni giornaliere nel laboratorio Microbiological QC (MBQC) e per mantenere il laboratorio operativo (incl. manutenzione di attrezzature).
- Responsabile per la creazione e la revisione di documenti di orientamento quali SOP/Wls e altri documenti correlati.
- System Matter Expert (SME) per Bioburden, Promozione della Crescita, Micro Identificazioni e metodo di test Endotoxin e relativi eventi di qualità.
- Partecipa al trasferimento, allo sviluppo e alla verifica/valida dei metodi microbiologici, compresa la qualificazione delle attrezzature necessarie per l'analisi.
- Test di prodotti finali e intermedi, in campioni di processo, campioni da convalida di pulizia, utilità e campioni di monitoraggio ambientale come backup.
- Supporta la disponibilità di controllo GMP di QC per garantire la piena conformità del relativo sistema di qualità e documenti procedurali.
- Supporti dei team QC (MBQC e Servizio e Supporto) nell'ordinazione di materiale, logistica di campioni e gestione dell'inventario dei laboratori QC.
- Atto come Responsabile della Biosicurezza presso il sito Thermo Fisher Scientific Lengnau in conformità con la legge svizzera (SAMV, ESV).

Requisiti:

- Minimo 4 anni di esperienza nel controllo della qualità in un ambiente regolamentato (dispositivo farmaceutico/medico)
- Campi di studio preferiti: Chimica, Biologia, o relativo campo scientifico
- Competenza dimostrata con apparecchiature e tecniche di test analitici (HPLC, GC, spettrofotometria)
- Forte comprensione dei requisiti cGMP e dei sistemi di qualità
- Esperienza con documentazione di qualità e recensione dei dati
- Prova capacità di guidare e mentore gli altri mantenendo standard di qualità
- Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e alle competenze organizzative
- Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta
- Proficienza con software standard per uffici e sistemi LIMS
- Capacità di lavorare in ambienti di cleanroom e seguire le procedure di abito
- Capacità fisica di resistere per lunghi periodi, sollevare fino a 25 lbs di tanto in tanto
- Flessibilità al lavoro di vari turni secondo le necessità
- Capacità di risolvere i problemi e la capacità di risolvere problemi tecnici
- Esperienza di scrittura e revisione SOP e documentazione tecnica

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Rotational shift nights/weekends

## Environmental Conditions

Able to lift 40 lbs. without assistance, Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, No contact lens allowed; prescriptive glasses will be provided

## Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an outstanding combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

The state-of-the-art multi-purpose manufacturing facility is crafted for large-scale production of biologics and has high expansion potential. After completion of construction activities, our site in Lengnau will offer highly flexible biomanufacturing technologies, from development to large-scale production including stainless steel equipment to meet our customer needs.

## Manufacturing Specialist / Media & Buffer Preparation

Location: Lengnau

As a **Manufacturing Specialist / Media & Buffer Preparation**, you conduct the production of recombinant products by operating automated production equipment and support project teams in the design, commissioning, qualification and validation of new production lines for recombinant products.

## Your responsibilities:

- Support operational readiness for Media buffer preparation, equipment preparation and cleaning.
- Participates in Technology Transfer of new products. Supports CVQ, PQ, Process Validation execution
- Responsible for the day-to-day execution of manufacturing activities in media & buffer preparation, equipment cleaning and preparation.
- Owns Work Instructions and SOP in their area
- Support Manufacturing Excellence to run robustly and efficiently.
- Participates in defining robust process parameters during routine manufacturing campaigns
- Participate in New Product Introduction activities

## Your qualifications:

- Degree in pharmaceutical, food or chemistry
- 1-3 years successful experience in pharmaceuticals operations in a GMP relevant environment
- Experience in pharmaceutical industry
- Hands on mentality
- Shift work is expected
- On-call duties is expected

**We offer** driven remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Location:

This position is part of the Microbiological Quality Control (MBQC) team from Thermo Fisher Scientific in **Lengnau (CH)**, supporting GMP-regulated manufacturing operations. The role operates within a laboratory environment focused on ensuring microbiological quality and compliance of pharmaceutical products and processes.

## How Will You Make an Impact?

You will ensure the microbiological quality and compliance of products, raw materials, and manufacturing environments through accurate sampling, testing, and analysis. Your work will directly support product safety, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

## A Day in the Life:

- Perform microbiological sampling and testing of final and intermediate products, in-process controls (IPC), raw materials, utilities, environmental monitoring samples, and cleaning validation samples.
- Conduct microbiological analyses including bioburden testing, bacterial endotoxin testing, and PCR-based methods while ensuring timely and compliant data reporting.
- Maintain, calibrate, and operate laboratory equipment; prepare microbiological media, reagents, standards, and test kits.

**Education**: (EMEA)

Bachelor in Life Sciences or diploma as laboratory technician with several years of professional experience in the field of microbiology / life sciences / biomedical or similar

## Experience:

Required: Minimum of 2 years of work experience in QA, QC, or a related field Preferred: Experience in a cGMP environment and microbiological laboratory operations

## Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

- Strong knowledge of microbiological testing techniques (bioburden, endotoxin, PCR) and laboratory best practices
- Familiarity with GMP requirements, method validation/verification, and documentation standards (SOPs, WIs)
- Ability to troubleshoot microbiological issues, support investigations, and collaborate in cross-functional teams

## Physical Requirements / Work Environment:

- Work is performed in a controlled laboratory environment with adherence to GMP and safety standards
- Requires use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and handling of biological materials
- May involve standing for extended periods, repetitive tasks, and precise manual work
- Weekend work may be required based on business and operational needs to support manufacturing activities and ensure timely microbiological testing

Garantirai la qualità microbiologica e la conformità dei prodotti, delle materie prime e degli ambienti di produzione attraverso campionamento, test e analisi accurate. - Familiarità con requisiti GMP, metodi di convalida/verificazione e standard di documentazione (SOP, WIs)

## Umweltbedingungen

Einhaltung aller Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Sicherheitsstandards

## Stellenbeschreibung

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kollegen erwecken wir unsere Mission jeden Tag zum Leben, damit unsere Kunden die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer machen können. Wir stellen unseren globalen Teams die Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um individuelle Karriereziele zu erreichen, und helfen gleichzeitig, die Wissenschaft einen Schritt weiter zu bringen, indem wir Lösungen für einige der schwierigsten Herausforderungen der Welt entwickeln, wie den Schutz der Umwelt, die Gewährleistung der Sicherheit unserer Lebensmittel oder die Suche nach Heilmitteln für Krebs.

## Standort:

Diese Position ist Teil des Teams für mikrobiologische Qualitätskontrolle (MBQC) von Thermo Fisher Scientific in **Lengnau (CH)**, das GMP-regulierte Fertigungsbetriebe unterstützt. Die Rolle spielt sich in einer Laborumgebung ab, die sich auf die Gewährleistung der mikrobiologischen Qualität und der Konformität pharmazeutischer Produkte und Prozesse konzentriert.

## Wie werden Sie eine Wirkung erzielen?

Sie gewährleisten die mikrobiologische Qualität und Konformität von Produkten, Rohstoffen und Fertigungsumgebungen durch genaue Probenahme, Tests und Analysen. Ihre Arbeit unterstützt direkt die Produktsicherheit, die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

## Ein Tag im Leben:

- Durchführung mikrobiologischer Probenahmen und Tests von End- und Zwischenprodukten, In-Prozess-Kontrollen (IPC), Rohstoffen, Versorgungseinrichtungen, Proben für die Umweltüberwachung und Proben für die Reinigungsvalidierung.
- Durchführung mikrobiologischer Analysen, einschließlich Bioburden-Tests, bakterieller Endotoxin-Tests und PCR-basierter Methoden, wobei eine zeitnahe und konforme Datenberichterstattung zu gewährleisten ist.
- Wartung, Kalibrierung und Betrieb von Laborgeräten; Vorbereitung mikrobiologischer Medien, Reagenzien, Standards und Testkits.

**Bildung**: (EMEA)

Bachelor in Life Sciences oder Diplom als Labortechniker mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung im Bereich Mikrobiologie / Biowissenschaften / Biomedizin oder ähnlich

## Erfahrung:

Erforderlich: Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in QA, QC oder einem verwandten Bereich Bevorzugt: Erfahrung in einer cGMP-Umgebung und mikrobiologischen Laborbetrieb

## Wissen, Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeiten:

- Umfangreiche Kenntnisse über mikrobiologische Testverfahren (Bioburden, Endotoxin, PCR) und bewährte Laborverfahren
- Vertrautheit mit GMP-Anforderungen, Validierung/Verifizierung von Methoden und Dokumentationsstandards (SOPs, WIs)
- Fähigkeit, mikrobiologische Probleme zu beheben, Untersuchungen zu unterstützen und in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten

## Körperliche Anforderungen / Arbeitsumgebung:

- Die Arbeiten werden in einer kontrollierten Laborumgebung unter Einhaltung von GMP und Sicherheitsstandards durchgeführt.
- Erfordert die Verwendung von persönlicher Schutzausrüstung (PSA) und den Umgang mit biologischem Material
- Kann längere Zeiträume, sich wiederholende Aufgaben und präzise manuelle Arbeit beinhalten
- Wochenendarbeit kann auf der Grundlage von geschäftlichen und betrieblichen Anforderungen erforderlich sein, um Produktionsaktivitäten zu unterstützen und rechtzeitige mikrobiologische Tests zu gewährleisten

Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire avancer la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, comme protéger l'environnement, s'assurer que nos aliments sont sûrs ou aider à trouver des remèdes pour le cancer.

## Lieu:

Ce poste fait partie de l'équipe de contrôle de la qualité microbiologique (CQM) de Thermo Fisher Scientific à **Lengnau (CH)**, qui soutient les activités de fabrication réglementées par les BPF. Ce rôle fonctionne dans un environnement de laboratoire axé sur la qualité microbiologique et la conformité des produits et procédés pharmaceutiques.

## Comment allez - vous avoir un impact?

Vous assurerez la qualité microbiologique et la conformité des produits, des matières premières et des environnements de fabrication grâce à un échantillonnage, des tests et des analyses précis. Votre travail appuiera directement la sécurité des produits, la conformité réglementaire et les initiatives d'amélioration continue.

## Un jour dans la vie:

- Effectuer l'échantillonnage microbiologique et l'analyse des produits finaux et intermédiaires, des contrôles en cours de fabrication (CPI), des matières premières, des services publics, des échantillons de surveillance environnementale et des échantillons de validation de nettoyage.
- Effectuer des analyses microbiologiques, y compris des tests de biocharge, des tests d'endotoxine bactérienne et des méthodes fondées sur la PCR, tout en veillant à ce que les données soient communiquées en temps opportun et en conformité.
- Entretenir, étalonner et utiliser du matériel de laboratoire; préparer des milieux microbiologiques, des réactifs, des étalons et des trousses d'essai.

**Éducation**: (EMEA)

Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie ou diplôme de technicien de laboratoire avec plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de la microbiologie / sciences de la vie / biomédicale ou similaire

## Expérience :

Obligatoire : minimum de 2 ans d'expérience de travail en QA, QC, ou dans un domaine connexe.

## Connaissances, compétences, capacités :

- Connaissance approfondie des techniques d'analyse microbiologique (biocharge, endotoxine, PCR) et des meilleures pratiques de laboratoire
- Connaissance des exigences des BPF, validation/vérification des méthodes et normes de documentation (SOP, WI)
- Capacité de résoudre les problèmes microbiologiques, de soutenir les enquêtes et de collaborer dans des équipes interfonctionnelles

## Exigences physiques/environnement de travail :

- Les travaux sont effectués dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, conformément aux BPF et aux normes de sécurité
- Exige l'utilisation d'équipements de protection individuelle (EPI) et la manipulation de matériaux biologiques
- Peut impliquer des périodes prolongées, des tâches répétitives et un travail manuel précis
- Des travaux de fin de semaine peuvent être nécessaires en fonction des besoins opérationnels et opérationnels pour appuyer les activités de fabrication et assurer des tests microbiologiques en temps opportun

## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Laboratory Setting, Loud Noises (Equipment/Machinery), Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.), Will work with hazardous/toxic materials

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

CMD; Unity Lab Services, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, provides critical on-site instrument services at customer locations. Our colleagues are passionate about improving customer experience and service operations efficiency.

**Location:** Switzerland

**Discover Impactful Work** This is an excellent opportunity to start your career in our growing Field Service team and make a difference. You will receive comprehensive training from our colleagues to support your development within Thermo Fisher Scientific. The focus of this role is the installation, preventive maintenance, instrument qualification, and troubleshooting of chromatographic (HPLC / IC) devices.

**A Day in the Life:** Collaborate with colleagues in the customer care center to efficiently schedule service visits and exceed customer expectations. Install chromatography products, demonstrate instrument specifications, and provide customer familiarization training. Perform preventive maintenance, qualifications, troubleshooting, and failure analysis while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal procedures. Maintain strong customer relationships and contribute to service performance targets.

## What to expect:

- Collaborate with customer care teams to plan and schedule service visits
- Install chromatography instruments and provide customer familiarization training
- Perform preventive maintenance and instrument qualification activities
- Troubleshoot and analyze instrument failures
- Prepare detailed service documentation in compliance with regulatory requirements
- Contribute to service targets including bookings, revenue, profitability, and cost management
- Follow all internal service procedures and customer regulations
- Build and maintain strong professional customer relationships
- Manage company assets including inventory, tools, software, and company vehicle
- Coordinate service planning with dispatchers, team leaders, and other stakeholders
- Travel extensively within Switzerland and occasionally internationally across EMEA and the United States

## Keys to Success:

## Education

- Technical education or chemical background
- Valid driving license

## Experience

- Experience with chromatography systems (HPLC / IC) preferred
- 2–3 years of experience servicing chromatography products or working as a user is advantageous
- Experience in customer-facing technical support environments is beneficial

## Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Curiosity about analytical instruments, systems, applications, new products, and technologies
- Proficient in German with good English language skills
- Strong hardware and software knowledge, particularly Windows operating systems and Microsoft Office applications
- Strong problem-solving abilities
- Proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
- Excellent interpersonal, self-motivation, and negotiation skills
- Willingness and passion for frequent travel

## Competencies

- Customer focus
- Team collaboration
- Accountability
- Adaptability
- Planning and organization
- Communication skills
- Continuous learning mindset
- Ethical and professional conduct

**Benefits:** We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day: enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, including protecting the environment, ensuring food safety, and helping find cures for cancer.

Join our Quality Control team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you will make meaningful contributions to our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

As an **Senior Scientist Electronic Laboratory Systems**, you will perform technical support activities and validation exercise to ensure product quality in a GMP-regulated environment. You will work with analytical equipment and electronic laboratory systems, supporting the qualification, validation, operation, and lifecycle management of QC systems and applications.

## Key Responsibilities

- Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot analytical laboratory equipment and electronic laboratory systems.
- Support qualification of analytical equipment and computerized system validation activities for QC laboratory systems.
- Generate, review, and maintain GxP documentation throughout the lifecycle of QC systems, equipment, and applications.
- Evaluate analytical data, document results accurately, and ensure compliance with applicable quality standards.
- Support investigations related to out-of-specification, out-of-expectation, deviations, change controls, and corrective and preventive actions.
- Provide timely technical support to QC laboratory units to ensure reliable laboratory operations.
- Support inspection and audit readiness activities, including gap assessments, remediation actions, and participation in customer or health authority inspections as needed.
- Contribute to the implementation of automated data flows, laboratory process improvements, and Practical Process Improvement initiatives.
- Support data integrity expectations by ensuring reliable, complete, accurate, and compliant laboratory records.
- Collaborate with Quality, Manufacturing, Manufacturing Science and Technology, Supply Chain, Maintenance and Facilities, Procurement, IT, and global laboratory systems teams.
- Adhere to cGMP, quality, EHSS, and site procedures.
- Actively contribute to continuous quality improvement, safety initiatives, deviation reporting, and near-miss follow-up.
- Demonstrate Thermo Fisher Scientific values through accountability, ethical behavior, customer focus, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration.

## Required Qualifications

- BSc or MSc in Lifes Sciences (Chemistry, Biochemistry, Physics, Microbiology or equivalent)
- Or IT/Automation background with strong knowledge and experience in the pharma industry
- Strong knowledge of GMP regulations, quality systems, and laboratory compliance requirements.
- Significant experience in a laboratory environment, experience in IT (Programming or Database)
- Computerized System Validation (CSV) and pharma industry Experience in Lab execution Systems as SM LIMS, Chromeleon, Lab X, Empower, etc. is a benefit
- Demonstrated ability to analyze data and support investigations of out-of-specification or atypical results.
- Strong documentation skills and ability to follow written and verbal procedures accurately.
- Familiarity with laboratory information management systems and electronic laboratory systems.
- Knowledge of relevant regulatory standards, including ISO, FDA, USP, and EP expectations.
- Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

## Programma di lavoro

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Condizioni ambientali

Aderenza a tutte le buone pratiche di fabbricazione (GMP) standard di sicurezza

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni singolo giorno: consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro.

Forniamo ai nostri team globali le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, aiutando a superare la scienza, sviluppando soluzioni per alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, tra cui la protezione dell’ambiente, la sicurezza alimentare e aiutando a trovare cure per il cancro.

Unisciti al nostro team di controllo qualità presso Thermo Fisher Scientific, dove potrai dare contributi significativi alla nostra missione di consentire ai clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro.

Come un **Senior Scientist Electronic Laboratory Systems**, eseguirai attività di supporto tecnico e attività di validazione per garantire la qualità del prodotto in un ambiente regolamentato da GMP. Potrai lavorare con apparecchiature analitiche e sistemi di laboratorio elettronici, supportando la qualificazione, la validazione, il funzionamento e la gestione del ciclo di vita dei sistemi e delle applicazioni QC.

## Principali responsabilità

- Operare, mantenere e risolvere i problemi di apparecchiature di laboratorio analitiche e sistemi di laboratorio elettronici.
- Qualifica di supporto delle apparecchiature analitiche e delle attività di convalida del sistema computerizzato per i sistemi di laboratorio QC.
- Generare, rivedere e mantenere la documentazione GxP durante il ciclo di vita dei sistemi, delle attrezzature e delle applicazioni QC.
- Valutare i dati analitici, i risultati dei documenti con precisione e garantire il rispetto degli standard di qualità applicabili.
- Indagini di supporto relative a out-of-specification, out-of-aspettatation, deviazioni, controlli di cambiamento e azioni correttive e preventive.
- Fornire assistenza tecnica tempestiva alle unità di laboratorio QC per garantire operazioni di laboratorio affidabili.
- Ispezione di sostegno e attività di prontezza di audit, comprese le valutazioni del gap, le azioni di bonifica e la partecipazione alle ispezioni del cliente o dell'autorità sanitaria secondo le necessità.
- Contribuisci all'implementazione di flussi di dati automatizzati, miglioramenti dei processi di laboratorio e iniziative di miglioramento dei processi pratici.
- Supporta le aspettative di integrità dei dati garantendo registrazioni di laboratorio affidabili, complete, accurate e conformi.
- Collabora con Quality, Manufacturing, Manufacturing Science and Technology, Supply Chain, Maintenance and Facilities, Procurement, IT e team di sistemi di laboratorio globali.
- Attenti a cGMP, qualità, EHSS e procedure del sito.
- Contribuire attivamente al miglioramento continuo della qualità, alle iniziative di sicurezza, alla segnalazione delle deviazioni e al follow-up quasi-up.
- Dimostrare i valori scientifici Thermo Fisher attraverso la responsabilità, il comportamento etico, l'attenzione del cliente, la curiosità intellettuale e la collaborazione.

## Qualificazioni richieste

- BSc o MSc in Scienze della Vita (Chimica, Biochimica, Fisica, Microbiologia o equivalente)
- O background IT/Automation con una forte conoscenza ed esperienza nel settore farmaceutico
- Forte conoscenza delle normative GMP, sistemi di qualità e requisiti di conformità di laboratorio.
- Esperienza significativa in un ambiente di laboratorio, esperienza in IT (Programming o Database)
- Convalida del sistema computerizzato (CSV) e industria farmaceutica Esperienza nei sistemi di esecuzione del laboratorio come SM LIMS, Chromeleon, Lab X, Empower, ecc è un vantaggio.
- Dimostrata capacità di analizzare i dati e di supportare le indagini su risultati fuori specifica o atipici.
- Forte capacità di documentazione e capacità di seguire accuratamente le procedure scritte e verbali.
- Familiarità con sistemi di gestione delle informazioni di laboratorio e sistemi di laboratorio elettronici.
- Conoscenza degli standard normativi rilevanti, comprese le aspettative ISO, FDA, USP e EP.
- Ottima attenzione ai dettagli, capacità organizzative e gestione del tempo.
- Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo in un ambiente di team.

## Arbeitsplan

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Umweltbedingungen

Einhaltung aller Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Sicherheitsstandards

## Stellenbeschreibung

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kollegen erwecken wir unsere Mission jeden Tag zum Leben: Unseren Kunden zu ermöglichen, die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer zu machen.

Wir stellen unseren globalen Teams die Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die erforderlich sind, um individuelle Karriereziele zu erreichen, und helfen gleichzeitig, die Wissenschaft einen Schritt weiter zu bringen, indem wir Lösungen für einige der schwierigsten Herausforderungen der Welt entwickeln, einschließlich des Umweltschutzes, der Gewährleistung der Lebensmittelsicherheit und der Suche nach Heilmitteln für Krebs.

Treten Sie unserem Qualitätskontrollteam von Thermo Fisher Scientific bei, wo Sie einen bedeutenden Beitrag zu unserer Mission leisten, unseren Kunden zu ermöglichen, die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer zu machen.

Als Senior Scientist Electronic Laboratory Systems führen Sie technische Support-Aktivitäten und Validierungsübungen durch, um die Produktqualität in einer GMP-regulierten Umgebung sicherzustellen. Sie arbeiten mit Analysegeräten und elektronischen Laborsystemen und unterstützen das Qualifizierungs-, Validierungs-, Betriebs- und Lebenszyklusmanagement von QC-Systemen und -Anwendungen.

## Hauptzuständigkeiten

- Betreiben, warten und beheben Sie analytische Laborgeräte und elektronische Laborsysteme.
- Unterstützung der Qualifizierung von Analysegeräten und computergestützten Systemvalidierungsaktivitäten für QC-Laborsysteme.
- Generieren, überprüfen und pflegen Sie die GxP-Dokumentation während des gesamten Lebenszyklus von QC-Systemen, -Geräten und -Anwendungen.
- Bewerten Sie analytische Daten, dokumentieren Sie die Ergebnisse genau und gewährleisten Sie die Einhaltung der geltenden Qualitätsstandards.
- Unterstützung von Untersuchungen im Zusammenhang mit Out-of-Spezifikation, Out-of-Expectation, Abweichungen, Änderungskontrollen sowie Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen.
- Zeitnahe technische Unterstützung für QC-Laboreinheiten, um einen zuverlässigen Laborbetrieb zu gewährleisten.
- Unterstützung von Inspektions- und Auditbereitschaftsaktivitäten, einschließlich Lückenbewertungen, Abhilfemaßnahmen und gegebenenfalls Teilnahme an Inspektionen von Kunden oder Gesundheitsbehörden.
- Beitrag zur Implementierung von automatisierten Datenflüssen, Laborprozessverbesserungen und Initiativen zur praktischen Prozessverbesserung.
- Unterstützen Sie die Erwartungen an die Datenintegrität, indem Sie zuverlässige, vollständige, genaue und konforme Laboraufzeichnungen sicherstellen.
- Zusammenarbeit mit Quality, Manufacturing, Manufacturing Science and Technology, Supply Chain, Maintenance and Facilities, Procurement, IT und globalen Laborsystemteams.
- Befolgen Sie die cGMP-, Qualitäts-, EHSS- und Standortverfahren.
- Tragen Sie aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Qualitätsverbesserung, zu Sicherheitsinitiativen, zur Abweichungsberichterstattung und zur Nachverfolgung von Beinahe-Fehlern bei.
- Demonstrieren Sie die wissenschaftlichen Werte von Thermo Fisher durch Rechenschaftspflicht, ethisches Verhalten, Kundenorientierung, intellektuelle Neugier und Zusammenarbeit.

## Benötigte Qualifikationen

- BSc oder MSc in Lifes Sciences (Chemie, Biochemie, Physik, Mikrobiologie oder gleichwertig)
- Oder IT / Automatisierung Hintergrund mit starkem Wissen und Erfahrung in der Pharmaindustrie
- Fundierte Kenntnisse der GMP-Vorschriften, Qualitätssysteme und Labor-Compliance-Anforderungen.
- Bedeutende Erfahrung in einer Laborumgebung, Erfahrung in IT (Programmierung oder Datenbank)
- Computerisierte Systemvalidierung (CSV) und Pharmaindustrie Erfahrung in Laborausführungssystemen wie SM LIMS, Chromeleon, Lab X, Empower usw. ist ein Vorteil
- Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Daten zu analysieren und Untersuchungen von Out-of-Spezifikationen oder atypischen Ergebnissen zu unterstützen.
- Starke Dokumentationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, schriftliche und mündliche Verfahren genau zu befolgen.
- Vertrautheit mit Laborinformationsmanagementsystemen und elektronischen Laborsystemen.
- Kenntnis der relevanten regulatorischen Standards, einschließlich ISO, FDA, USP und EP Erwartungen.
- Ausgezeichnete Liebe zum Detail, organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Zeitmanagement.
- Fähigkeit, unabhängig und kollaborativ in einer Teamumgebung zu arbeiten.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
## Calendrier des travaux

Norme (Mon-Fri)

## Conditions environnementales

Respect de toutes les bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF)

## Description de l'emploi

Dans le cadre de l'équipe Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous découvrirez un travail significatif qui a un impact positif à l'échelle mondiale. Rejoignez nos collègues pour donner vie à notre mission tous les jours : permettre à nos clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr.

Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire progresser la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, y compris la protection de l'environnement, la sécurité alimentaire et la recherche de remèdes pour le cancer.

Rejoignez notre équipe de contrôle de la qualité chez Thermo Fisher Scientific, où vous apporterez une contribution significative à notre mission de permettre aux clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr.

En tant que **Scientifique principal Systèmes de laboratoire électroniques**, vous effectuerez des activités de soutien technique et des exercices de validation pour assurer la qualité du produit dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF. Vous travaillerez avec l'équipement analytique et les systèmes de laboratoire électroniques, en soutenant la qualification, la validation, le fonctionnement et la gestion du cycle de vie des systèmes et des applications de QC.

## Principales responsabilités

- Exploiter, entretenir et dépanner l'équipement de laboratoire analytique et les systèmes de laboratoire électronique.
- Appuyer la qualification du matériel d'analyse et les activités de validation des systèmes informatisés pour les systèmes de laboratoire de QC.
- Générer, examiner et maintenir la documentation GxP tout au long du cycle de vie des systèmes, de l'équipement et des applications de QC.
- Évaluer les données analytiques, documenter avec exactitude les résultats et assurer la conformité aux normes de qualité applicables.
- Appuyer les enquêtes liées à la non-spécification, à la non-attente, aux écarts, aux contrôles du changement et aux mesures correctives et préventives.
- Fournir un soutien technique opportun aux unités de laboratoire du CQ pour assurer la fiabilité des opérations de laboratoire.
- Appuyer les activités d'inspection et de préparation à la vérification, y compris les évaluations des lacunes, les mesures d'assainissement et la participation aux inspections des clients ou des autorités sanitaires au besoin.
- Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre des flux automatisés de données, des améliorations des processus de laboratoire et des initiatives d'amélioration pratique des processus.
- Soutenir les attentes en matière d'intégrité des données en assurant la fiabilité, l'exhaustivité, l'exactitude et la conformité des dossiers de laboratoire.
- Collaborer avec les équipes de la qualité, de la fabrication, de la science et de la technologie de la fabrication, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de l'entretien et des installations, de l'approvisionnement, de l'informatique et des systèmes de laboratoire mondiaux.
- Adhérer au GMPc, à la qualité, à l'ESS et aux procédures du site.
- Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue de la qualité, aux initiatives en matière de sécurité, aux rapports sur les écarts et au suivi quasi manquant.
- Démontrer les valeurs scientifiques de Thermo Fisher par la responsabilisation, le comportement éthique, l'orientation client, la curiosité intellectuelle et la collaboration.

## Qualifications requises

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences de la vie (chimie, biochimie, physique, microbiologie ou équivalent)
- Ou de l'informatique/l'automatisation avec une solide connaissance et expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique
- Bonne connaissance des règlements sur les BPF, des systèmes de qualité et des exigences de conformité des laboratoires.
- Expérience importante dans un environnement de laboratoire, expérience en TI (programmation ou base de données)
- Validation informatisée des systèmes (CSV) et de l'industrie pharmaceutique Expérience dans les systèmes d'exécution de laboratoire comme SM LIMS, Chromeleon, Lab X, Empower, etc. est un avantage
- Capacité démontrée d'analyser les données et d'appuyer les enquêtes sur les résultats non spécifiques ou atypiques.
- De solides compétences en documentation et la capacité de suivre les procédures écrites et verbales avec exactitude.
- Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de l'information en laboratoire et des systèmes de laboratoire électroniques.
- Connaissance des normes réglementaires pertinentes, y compris l'ISO, la FDA, l'USP et les attentes du PE.
- Excellente attention aux détails, aux compétences organisationnelles et à la gestion du temps.
- Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en collaboration dans un environnement d'équipe.

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

As a Manufacturing Engineer III at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will optimize production processes, implement new technologies, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. You'll work with cross-functional teams to ensure the efficient manufacture of high-quality products while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements. This position offers the opportunity to contribute meaningfully by enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer through innovative manufacturing solutions.
You will manage process improvement projects, provide technical expertise for new product introductions, develop and validate manufacturing processes, and implement automation solutions. Working with R&D, Quality, Production, and other departments, you'll optimize existing processes while ensuring consistent product quality and regulatory compliance. Your analytical skills and engineering expertise will help drive cost reductions, improve efficiencies, and enhance manufacturing capabilities across our operations.

• Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial or related field)
• Professional Engineer (PE) license or relevant certifications beneficial
• Lean Six Sigma certification preferred
• Strong knowledge of GMP, ISO standards, and regulatory requirements
• Expertise in process validation, equipment qualification, and change control management
• Proficient in statistical analysis and continuous improvement methodologies
• Experience with automation systems, PLCs, and manufacturing control systems
• Strong project management skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams
• Demonstrated success implementing process improvements and cost reduction initiatives
• Experience with CAD software and manufacturing documentation systems
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic manufacturing environment
• Experience supporting engineers and technicians
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite and relevant engineering software
• Ability to travel up to 20% as needed
• Must be able to work in cleanroom environments when required
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
• Experience with risk assessment methodologies and root cause analysis
• Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles and tools

Potrai lavorare con team multifunzionali per garantire la produzione efficiente di prodotti di alta qualità, mantenendo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi. Questa posizione offre l'opportunità di contribuire in modo significativo consentendo ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, pulito e sicuro attraverso soluzioni di produzione innovative.
Potrai gestire i progetti di miglioramento del processo, fornire competenze tecniche per nuove presentazioni di prodotto, sviluppare e convalidare i processi di produzione e implementare soluzioni di automazione. Lavorando con R&D, Quality, Production e altri dipartimenti, ottimizzate i processi esistenti garantendo al contempo una qualità costante del prodotto e una conformità normativa. Le tue capacità analitiche e competenze ingegneristiche aiuteranno a ridurre i costi, migliorare le efficienze e migliorare le capacità produttive attraverso le nostre operazioni.

## Description de l'emploi

Dans le cadre de l'équipe Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous découvrirez un travail significatif qui a un impact positif à l'échelle mondiale. Rejoignez nos collègues pour donner vie à notre mission tous les jours afin de permettre à nos clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr. Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire avancer la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, comme protéger l'environnement, s'assurer que nos aliments sont sûrs ou aider à trouver des remèdes pour le cancer.
DESCRIPTION:
En tant qu'ingénieur de fabrication III chez Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous optimiserez les processus de production, appliquerez de nouvelles technologies et lancerez des initiatives d'amélioration continue. Vous travaillerez avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour assurer la fabrication efficace de produits de haute qualité tout en respectant les exigences réglementaires. Cette position offre l'occasion de contribuer de manière significative en permettant à nos clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr grâce à des solutions de fabrication innovantes.
Vous gérerez des projets d'amélioration des processus, fournirez une expertise technique pour les nouvelles introductions de produits, développerez et validerez les processus de fabrication et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'automatisation. En travaillant avec la R-D, la qualité, la production et d'autres ministères, vous optimiserez les processus existants tout en assurant la qualité des produits et la conformité réglementaire. Vos compétences en analyse et en ingénierie contribueront à réduire les coûts, à améliorer l'efficacité et à améliorer les capacités de fabrication dans l'ensemble de nos activités.
EXIGENCES:
• Diplôme avancé plus 3 ans d'expérience, ou baccalauréat plus 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie de fabrication dans les industries réglementées (pharmacie, instrument médical ou similaire)

## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
DESCRIPTION:
Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to advancing clinical research. As a Client Services Project Manager I, you'll support clinical trials by managing project documentation, coordinating supply chain activities, and ensuring consistent delivery of services. Work closely with internal teams and clients to support study success while maintaining the highest quality standards. You'll handle project planning, documentation management, and cross-functional coordination to meet timelines and client expectations.
REQUIREMENTS:
• Bachelor's degree required, no prior experience required, preferably in clinical trials or pharmaceutical industry
• Preferred Fields of Study: healthcare, supply chain management, life sciences, or related field
• Project Management certification from recognized institution beneficial
• Strong understanding of GMP/GxP principles and quality management systems
• Demonstrated project management skills with ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Project
• Experience with enterprise systems like Salesforce, GPMS, and TrackWise preferred
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and documentation abilities
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams
• Fluent English required, additional languages beneficial
• Experience coordinating with teams and managing stakeholder relationships
• Ability to analyze data and generate clear, accurate reports
• Focus on quality service and continuous improvement
• Adaptable to changing priorities while maintaining attention to detail
• Travel to client sites or other facilities may be required

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. **We are the Clinical Trials Division (CTD): We Supply the Hope that Changes Lives** CTD partners with pharmaceutical and biotech customers around the world to ensure the right patients get the right therapies in the right doses at the right time - a concept that we internally adopt as "There is a Patient Waiting." Our unique blend of services includes project management, packaging, distribution, transportation management and specialty logistics, ancillary supply management, clinical supply optimization, bio-repository storage and much more. Our more than 4000 employees in over 15 countries work hard every day knowing that what they do matters. **Your Role in that Mission: As a member of Global Client Services, you are part of One Global Team: Empowered to Act, Make Connections and Get Results for our customers and their patients.** The Demand and Supply Management Coordinator is a key member of our Demand Planning team and provides crucial support to enable the team to provide specialized technical services to clients as part of our enhanced service offerings. Specifically, this role plays a key role in documentation, forecasting support and overall support to the planning team. **Key 
• Responsibilities:** Review and Action Supply Plan in collaboration with the Demand and Supply Manager, proactively managing shipments and inventory movement

Support supply chain inventory management processes in partnership with the Demand Planning team, management team members and packaging partners. Collects all information on a study design including: accurate label text, coordination of primary, secondary packaging material and tools, coordination of label translation, Supports connections between demand planning team and S&OP to ensure the latest forecast information is aggregated and integrated into the divisional S&OP process Summarize data, prepare presentations and make recommendations for action relative to the clinical supply chain and packaging plans Support User Acceptance and Testing for new process and system implementations as required. Review IRT settings and make recommendation to adjust and optimize accordingly Ensure temperature excursion process is performed as required Establish and maintain financial forecasts and monthly billing processes for assigned client projects to support the Demand planning team Support close out activities including returned good reconciliation, inventory destruction processing, and file archiving Demonstrate and promote company vision. Conduct activities in a safe and efficient manner **As Demonstrated By:  Project Management** Speaks and writes in a clear, concise, and organized way. Listens carefully to others to ensure understanding and effective communication. Structures Demand Planning requirements in line with clients strategy throughout the planning process **Technical Knowledge** Independently digests data that is applicable to project deliverables and stakeholders. Manages projects efficiently in different systems and maintains their own accountability for using Thermo Fisher tools

to help the team be successful. Demonstrates comfort with technology. Knowledge of general inventory and billing principles, good documentation practices, and report generation **Project Management Leadership** Communicates at the proper time, understands boundaries, respects differences, and confronts tension. Works with others to quickly resolve or escalate solutions to problems. **Key 
• Requirements: Education:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent To foster a sense of belonging and connection, remote employees are expected to keep their camera on and participate in video calls both internally and externally, as appropriate. **Years of Experience:** 2 years of supply chain and/or planning experience managing global supply chain design and logistics management, preferably as they relate to clinical program design and execution Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

per aiutare la squadra ad avere successo. Dimostra comfort con la tecnologia. Notre combinaison unique de services comprend la gestion de projet, l'emballage, la distribution, la gestion du transport et la logistique spécialisée, la gestion de l'approvisionnement auxiliaire, l'optimisation de l'approvisionnement clinique, le stockage bio-résistant et bien plus encore. Nos plus de 4000 employés dans plus de 15 pays travaillent dur chaque jour en sachant que ce qu'ils font est important. **Votre rôle dans cette mission : En tant que membre de Global Client Services, vous faites partie de One Global Team: Empowered to Act, Make Connections and Get Results pour nos clients et leurs patients.** Le coordonnateur de la gestion de la demande et de l'offre est un membre clé de notre équipe de planification de la demande et fournit un soutien crucial pour permettre à l'équipe de fournir des services techniques spécialisés aux clients dans le cadre de nos offres de services améliorées. Plus précisément, ce rôle joue un rôle clé dans la documentation, l'appui aux prévisions et l'appui global à l'équipe de planification. ** Clé
• Responsabilités** Examen et plan d'action en collaboration avec le gestionnaire de la demande et de l'approvisionnement, gestion proactive des expéditions et du mouvement des stocks

Soutenir les processus de gestion des stocks de la chaîne d'approvisionnement en partenariat avec l'équipe de planification de la demande, les membres de l'équipe de gestion et les partenaires d'emballage. Recueille tous les renseignements sur la conception d'une étude, y compris : le texte exact de l'étiquette, la coordination du matériel et des outils d'emballage primaire et secondaire, la coordination de la traduction de l'étiquette, Soutient les liens entre l'équipe de planification de la demande et les S&OP afin de s'assurer que les données les plus récentes sont agrégées et intégrées au processus de S&OP divisionnaire Résumer les données, préparer des présentations et formuler des recommandations d'action concernant la chaîne d'approvisionnement clinique et les plans d'emballage. Examiner les paramètres de l'IRT et recommander d'ajuster et d'optimiser en conséquence Veiller à ce que le processus d'excursion en température soit exécuté au besoin Établir et maintenir des prévisions financières et des processus de facturation mensuels pour les projets clients assignés afin d'appuyer l'équipe de planification de la demande Appuyer les activités de clôture, y compris le bon rapprochement retourné, le traitement de la destruction des stocks et l'archivage des fichiers Démontrer et promouvoir la vision de l'entreprise. Mener des activités de façon sécuritaire et efficace **Comme l'a démontré : Gestion de projet** Parle et écrit de manière claire, concise et organisée. Écoute attentivement les autres pour assurer la compréhension et une communication efficace. Structures Demande Exigences de planification conformes à la stratégie des clients tout au long du processus de planification **Savoirs techniques** Digérer indépendamment les données applicables aux produits livrables et aux intervenants du projet. Gérer efficacement les projets dans différents systèmes et maintenir leur propre responsabilité pour l'utilisation des outils Thermo Fisher

pour aider l'équipe à réussir. Démontre le confort avec la technologie. Connaissance des principes généraux d'inventaire et de facturation, des bonnes pratiques de documentation et de la production de rapports ** Leadership en gestion de projet** Communiquer au bon moment, comprendre les frontières, respecter les différences et affronter la tension. Travailler avec d'autres pour résoudre rapidement ou intensifier les solutions aux problèmes. ** Clé
• Exigences : Éducation** Baccalauréat ou équivalent Pour favoriser un sentiment d'appartenance et de connexion, les employés distants sont censés garder leur appareil photo allumé et participer à des appels vidéo à l'interne et à l'externe, selon le cas. **Années d'expérience :** 2 ans d'expérience en chaîne d'approvisionnement et/ou en planification en gestion de la conception et de la gestion logistique de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale, de préférence en ce qui a trait à la conception et à l'exécution des programmes cliniques Thermo Fisher Scientific est un Employeur responsable de l'EEO/Affirmative Action.
